title: Associate Director Domain Consulting(Retail)
description:
**Job Description** 




**Ciklum** 
 is looking for an
 **Associate Director Domain Consulting** 
 to join our team full\-time in India.
 



 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
 



**About The Role** 




 We are seeking a seasoned, high\-impact an Associate Director Domain Consulting to anchor and scale our Retail \& Consumer Goods (RCG) vertical. With 12–15 years of industry expertise, you will act as the core consultative bridge between our global clients business challenges and our advanced IT and Digital Engineering services. In this role, your primary responsibility will be up\-front business consulting, proactive discovery, and strategic advisory. You will lead high\-value presales engagements, shape proactive transformational pitches, and author industry\-specific solutions across Digital Experience, Merchandising, and E\-commerce ecosystems. You will partner closely with Regional Sales Leaders and Technical Solution Architects to accelerate pipeline conversion and position our firm as an elite digital transformation partner.
 



**Responsibilities** 



1. **Domain Consulting \& Advisory (50%)**


* Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the global designated authority on modern RCG workflows, driving the foundational business strategy across:



 Digital Experience: Personalization engines, loyalty frameworks, omnichannel customer journeys, and next\-generation smart\-store tech
 



 Merchandising: Inventory optimization, automated assortment planning, dynamic pricing strategies, and end\-to\-end supply chain visibility
 



 E\-commerce Ecosystems: Modern headless/composable commerce architecture, global marketplace integrations, and frictionless checkout optimization
 


* Discovery Workshops: Architect and lead consultative discovery sessions with enterprise\-tier prospective clients to unearth hidden operational pain points and map out actionable digital transformation roadmaps
* Strategic Client Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to prospective client executives, bridging the gap between their business pain points and our technical delivery capabilities long before an RFP is issued



**Presales, Bid Advisory \& Solutioning (35%)** 



* Own the Domain Story: Author end\-to\-end functional and business solutions for complex RFPs, RFIs, and high\-value proactive pitches within the RCG space
* Value Proposition Engineering: Translate traditional retail business challenges into cutting\-edge Digital Engineering, Cloud, Data, and AI solutions
* Deal Governance: Partner closely with Regional Bid Managers and Technical Architects to ensure final engineering designs map perfectly back to the client’s expected business value outcomes
* Defense \& Presentation: Lead orals and solution defense sessions with global prospect stakeholders (C\-level, VPs, Directors) to instill absolute confidence in our vertical capability



**Collateral \& Capability Building (15%)** 



* IP Development: Author forward\-looking white papers, case studies, point\-of\-view (POV) documents, and reusable retail\-specific capability frameworks
* Market Intelligence: Collaborate with the Enablement/Research team to analyze global retail trends, tech disruptions, and competitive landscapes to continuously optimize our market messaging
* Sample KRAs: Deal Win Ratio \& Conversion, Revenue Generation \& Pipeline Influence, Consulting Billability \& Utilization, Thought Leadership \& IP Creation, Solution Quality \& Stakeholder CSAT



**Requirements** 



* Overall Experience: 12–15 years of professional IT/Digital Services experience, with a minimum of 10\+ years dedicated strictly to Domain Consulting, Pre\-sales, \& Solutioning within the RCG domain
* Services Portfolio: Proven track record of winning large\-scale deals in Digital Engineering, Custom Application Development, Cloud Migrations, and Data/Analytics environments
* Domain Track Record: Demonstrable portfolio of shaping solutions across E\-commerce platforms (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe/Magento, Commercetools, or custom MACH setups), Unified Merchandising systems, and Digital CX platforms
* Core Competencies:
* Consultative Selling: Ability to pivot fluidly from a high\-level business strategy conversation with a retail Chief Marketing/Operating Officer to a technical alignment discussion with a Chief Architect
* Communication \& Presence: Exceptional verbal, written, and narrative storytelling skills. Ability to write clear, compelling proposal responses that avoid technical jargon where appropriate
* Collaborative Mindset: Experience working in a global matrixed environment, seamlessly orchestrating inputs from localized sales reps, technical leads, and shared enablement utilities
* Education:
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* An MBA or equivalent post\-graduate management degree from a tier\-1 institute is highly preferred



**What’s in it for you?** 



* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations



**About Us** 




 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
 



 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
 



**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!** 




 Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

 As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you will own the end\-to\-end implementation lifecycle of our procurement SaaS platform. You will work closely with clients, product teams, and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable, integrated, and intelligent procurement solutions.
 



 You will also contribute to embedding AI capabilities into procurement workflows, enhancing efficiency, decision\-making, and user experience.

 Implementation \& Delivery
 



  




* Lead end\-to\-end implementation of procurement SaaS solutions for global clients.
* Gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into scalable solution designs.
* Configure and customize the platform to align with client\-specific procurement processes.
* Drive integration with ERP and third\-party systems using APIs and middleware.
* Manage and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring high\-quality deployments.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with high customer satisfaction.



  





 Client Engagement \& Enablement
 



  




* Act as a trusted advisor to clients on procurement transformation and best practices.
* Conduct training sessions, workshops, and enablement programs to drive adoption.
* Provide post\-go\-live support and continuous improvement recommendations.



  





 AI \& Digital Transformation Initiatives
 



  




* Collaborate with product and data teams to implement AI\-powered features such as:
* Intelligent invoice processing and automation
* Predictive spend analytics and insights
* Supplier risk scoring and recommendation engines
* Identify opportunities to embed AI/ML into procurement workflows to improve efficiency and decision\-making.
* Drive adoption of automation, chatbots, and AI assistants within procurement processes.
* Analyze client data to recommend data\-driven optimizations and process improvements.
* Contribute to defining AI use cases, solution design, and value realization frameworks.
* Stay current with advancements in AI, GenAI, and automation within procurement and enterprise SaaS.



  





 Collaboration \& Leadership
 



  




* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including Product, Engineering, and Project Management.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to knowledge sharing and best practices.

 Education
 



  




* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field.



  





 Experience
 



  




* 6–10 years of experience in SaaS implementation, preferably in procurement or supply chain solutions.
* Strong expertise in S2P and P2P processes.
* Hands\-on experience with any one of these platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Jaggaer, Basware, or similar.
* Proven experience in system configuration, customization, and ERP integrations.
* Exposure to APIs, data integration, and cloud technologies.



  





 Preferred Skills

* Familiarity with Agile/Waterfall project methodologies.
* Strong problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced, global environment.



  





 Location: Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work with leading global enterprises to drive digital and AI\-led procurement transformation.
* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS organization at the forefront of AI innovation in procurement.
* Thrive in a collaborative, high\-impact, and innovation\-driven environment.
* Opportunity to shape next\-generation intelligent procurement solutions.

 Me100 is redefining where health begins in India by focusing on early signals of disease long before symptoms appear. The company offers advanced testing beyond standard full body checkups, using over 100 biomarkers across more than 13 body systems. Me100 combines family history, medical context, and lifestyle data into a single connected picture, reviewed by biomedical experts, with two in\-depth readings each year to track changes in the body. Individuals receive insights on biological age versus calendar age, along with a personalized action plan after each reading. At\-home sample collection is enabled through leading NABL\-accredited labs across 200\+ cities, supporting people to think long\-term about their health and well\-being.
   

**Role Description**

The manager will conduct regular field visits, present Me100’s offerings, negotiate terms, and ensure smooth execution of partnership agreements. * Self\-driven, organized, and able to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Role: Solution Architect – Semantic Governance AI Platform
   

 Engagement: Project / Contract / Strategic Collaboration
   

 Experience: 8\+ years preferred
   

 Domain: Enterprise Data Governance \| AI/ML \| Semantic Architecture \| Knowledge Graphs
   

 Location: Remote / Hybrid
   

  

 About the Project
   

  

 We are building an enterprise Semantic Governance AI Platform that establishes authoritative business definitions, manages semantic conflicts, maintains regulatory and decision provenance, and ensures approved definitions are consistently implemented across data warehouses, BI platforms, ML systems and enterprise applications.
   

  

 The platform will integrate with technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Power BI, Tableau, Collibra/Alation and enterprise data platforms.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect who can own the end\-to\-end technical architecture and work closely with business stakeholders, Data Governance teams, Data Scientists, Data Engineers and development teams.
   

  

 The architect will translate business governance requirements into a scalable architecture covering semantic modeling, workflow, AI, knowledge graphs, integrations, security, APIs and enterprise data platforms.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Architecture
   

  

 \* Design the end\-to\-end architecture for the Semantic Governance Platform.
   

 \* Define application, data, integration, semantic and AI architecture.
   

 \* Design the canonical semantic registry and concept/version model.
   

 \* Define architecture for ontology and knowledge\-graph components.
   

 \* Design workflow architecture for proposal, review, approval, escalation and deprecation.
   

 \* Define APIs and integration patterns for enterprise platforms.
   

  

 Data \& Semantic Architecture
   

  

 \* Design semantic models for business concepts, relationships, formulas and dependencies.
   

 \* Define metadata, lineage and provenance architecture.
   

 \* Design mechanisms for identifying conflicting definitions.
   

 \* Define semantic impact\-analysis architecture.
   

 \* Establish standards for canonical definitions and version management.
   

  

 AI Architecture
   

  

 \* Design AI/LLM components for:
   

 \* Semantic similarity
   

 \* Concept matching
   

 \* Conflict detection
   

 \* Regulatory document analysis
   

 \* Impact analysis
   

 \* AI\-assisted governance
   

 \* Define appropriate use of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG and knowledge graphs.
   

 \* Establish human\-in\-the\-loop controls so AI recommendations do not automatically become authoritative definitions.
   

 \* Define evaluation, explainability and guardrail mechanisms.
   

  

 Enterprise Integration
   

  

 Design integration patterns with:
   

  

 \* Snowflake
   

 \* Databricks
   

 \* Power BI
   

 \* Tableau
   

 \* Collibra / Alation
   

 \* Data catalogs
   

 \* Feature stores
   

 \* Enterprise APIs
   

 \* Existing Claims, Underwriting and Finance systems
   

  

 Security \& Compliance
   

  

 \* Design RBAC and fine\-grained access controls.
   

 \* Define authentication/authorization architecture.
   

 \* Design immutable/tamper\-evident audit architecture.
   

 \* Address encryption, secrets management and data protection.
   

 \* Ensure architecture supports enterprise security and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Technical Leadership
   

  

 \* Create HLD and LLD architecture documentation.
   

 \* Produce architecture diagrams using Draw.io, Lucidchart or Mermaid.
   

 \* Create API, integration and data\-flow specifications.
   

 \* Participate in technical discussions with client stakeholders.
   

 \* Guide engineering teams during implementation.
   

 \* Conduct architecture reviews and identify technical risks.
   

 \* Make technology and architectural trade\-off decisions.
   

  

 Required Technical Skills
   

  

 Must Have:
   

  

 \* 8\+ years of enterprise solution architecture experience.
   

 \* Strong experience with data platforms and enterprise integration.
   

 \* Strong understanding of Data Governance and Metadata Management.
   

 \* Experience with cloud architecture — AWS, Azure or GCP.
   

 \* Strong SQL and data architecture knowledge.
   

 \* REST APIs and event\-driven architecture.
   

 \* Experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks.
   

 \* Experience integrating BI platforms such as Power BI/Tableau.
   

 \* Understanding of ontology, semantic models or knowledge graphs.
   

 \* Strong understanding of AI/ML architecture and LLM\-based applications.
   

 \* Experience with security, RBAC and enterprise architecture patterns.
   

  

 Good to Have:
   

  

 \* Neo4j / Amazon Neptune / other graph databases.
   

 \* RAG and vector databases.
   

 \* Python.
   

 \* LangChain / LlamaIndex or equivalent frameworks.
   

 \* Collibra / Alation.
   

 \* Microsoft Purview.
   

 \* Data lineage platforms.
   

 \* Regulatory/compliance technology.
   

 \* Insurance, Banking, Financial Services or Risk domain experience.
   

  

 Expected Deliverables
   

  

 The Solution Architect will be responsible for producing:
   

  

 1\. End\-to\-End Solution Architecture
   

 2\. Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
   

 3\. High\-Level Architecture (HLD)
   

 4\. Low\-Level Architecture (LLD)
   

 5\. Semantic/Knowledge Graph Architecture
   

 6\. AI/LLM Architecture
   

 7\. Integration Architecture
   

 8\. Security Architecture
   

 9\. API Architecture
   

 10\. Data Flow \& Sequence Diagrams
   

 11\. Deployment Architecture
   

 12\. Technology Selection \& Trade\-off Analysis
   

 13\. POC Architecture
   

 14\. Implementation Roadmap
   

 15\. Technical Standards for Engineering Teams
   

  

 Key Question We Expect the Architect to Solve
   

  

 The architect should be able to answer:
   

  

 How do we take an approved business definition such as “Loss Ratio”, represent it as a canonical semantic object, map it to regulatory requirements, detect conflicting implementations in Snowflake/Power BI/ML systems, perform impact analysis when the definition changes, and propagate the approved version across the enterprise — while keeping humans accountable for the final decision?
   

  

 Ideal Candidate
   

  

 We are looking for someone who can operate at both levels:
   

  

 Business → Architecture → Engineering
   

  

 and can confidently sit with:
   

  

 CDO / CFO / CRO → Data Governance → Enterprise Architects → Data Scientists → Data Engineers → Developers
   

  

 and convert the business requirement into an executable technical architecture.

**The Role**
 The Strategy \& Value Insights Lead is responsible for enabling business leaders understand markets performance along with key drivers with actionable and impactful insights. This professional needs to be able to examine data, derive patterns, infer insights in the lens of business context and generate easy to understand business narratives.
   

  

 The Power BI \& Executive Insights Lead will design, develop and maintain executive reporting solutions, dashboards and analytical products for USLI leadership. The role combines Power BI development, data modelling and visualization with business analytics to transform Markets and performance data into clear, actionable executive insights. The successful candidate will understand the EY reporting environment and collaborate with business stakeholders, data owners and Global Analytics teams to deliver trusted, scalable and decision\-ready reporting.

* Build efficiencies, automation and standardization of data workflows

**Executive Insights \& Analytics**

* Translate complex analysis into concise business narratives, visuals and recommendations for leadership decision\-making.
* Support performance diagnostics, planning, forecasting and leadership review cycles.

**Data Management, Governance \& Innovation**

* Understanding of revenue, sales, pipeline, pursuits, growth and performance metrics.

* Experience with EY reporting, Markets data, Global Analytics or a comparable professional services reporting environment is preferred.
* Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in analytics, information systems, business, statistics, engineering or a related discipline.

title: Account Management Associate
description:
**The short version:**




  





**Who we’re looking for:** 
 People who are great at building relationships and keeping things moving. You’re probably the one who remembers every deadline, checks in with everyone, and somehow manages to keep it all together when things get hectic. If you’re someone who enjoys working with people, balancing multiple priorities, and seeing plans turn into results, you’ll fit right in here.
 



  





**What this role is about:** 
 You’ll work with our recruiter partners \- the companies that hire from Kraftshala \- to make their hiring experience seamless. From setting up placement drives and coordinating with internal teams to solving last\-minute challenges, you’ll be the bridge that keeps everything connected and running smoothly.
 



  





**Why you should apply:** 
 This is a role where you’ll see your work translate into real outcomes \- recruiters finding the right talent and students landing their first jobs. You’ll sharpen your communication, problem\-solving, and relationship\-management skills \- the kind that’ll set you up for any leadership or business role in the future. And the cherry on top? You’ll get to build a network that most people only dream of \- working directly with the top leadership of some of India’s best brands and marketing agencies.
 



  





**About us:** 
 Kraftshala is India's largest skilling institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate overall and a 100% placement rate in our sales programs, and we are gunning to become the world's largest career launchpad, across domains.
 



  





 We're backed by a number of eminent investors including ex\-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.
 



  





**The detailed version:**




  





 One of the biggest reasons students choose Kraftshala is our strong placement outcomes, and one of the biggest reasons companies continue to hire from Kraftshala is our track record of seamless execution, strong candidate quality, and consistent recruiter experience \- and that’s exactly why the Recruiter Partnerships (Account Management) team is such a critical part of the organization.
 



  





**Primary Responsibilities will include:** 




  





***Placement Operations***



* Managing end\-to\-end placement drives for assigned recruiter accounts, ensuring timelines and quality standards are consistently met
* Planning and executing placement logistics \- interview schedules, assessments, candidate lists \- in close coordination with hiring teams and internal stakeholders
* Serving as the primary point of contact for recruiters during the placement cycle, ensuring proactive communication and prompt resolution of queries
* Collaborating with student\-facing and operations teams to ensure students are well\-prepared and responsive throughout the process
* Tracking and analyzing performance data (e.g. interview conversion rates, recruiter feedback) to identify trends and improvement areas
* Identifying opportunities to grow and retain recruiter relationships through consistent delivery and trust\-building



  





***Process Optimization***




 Every delayed email, broken link, or missed follow\-up can erode trust \- and in placements, trust is everything. That’s why we’re constantly refining the way we operate, and hence, you’d be:
 


* Utilizing an array of tools, softwares, and platforms to automate processes in order to minimize human intervention and ensuring a flawless and effortless delivery of our placement cycles.
* Facilitating seamless collaboration with the product team to introduce innovative platform features and enhance operational efficiency.



  





**Monthly Outcomes:**



* **Month 1:** 
 Understand all current placement processes, tools, and workflows. Assist in 2\-3 drives and begin managing recruiter and student interactions.
* **Month 2:** 
 Run 3\-4 recruiter accounts independently with 90%\+ student participation and \<24hr query response time. Identify 3\-5 process gaps.
* **Month 3\+:** 
 Implement at least 2 process improvements. Maintain Recruiter and Student NPS. Drive at least one automation initiative.



  





***A question we’d like to address upfront is what the career trajectory looks like for someone in this role.***




  





 At Kraftshala, operations are central to how we serve our stakeholders. You'll start by learning the craft of partnerships and account management through hands\-on placement execution. Over time, two broad paths could open up:
 


* If your strengths lie in scaling processes, systems thinking, and managing cross\-functional execution, you could lead placement operations \- shaping how we deliver outcomes to recruiters and students at scale.
* If you love building and growing relationships, you could transition into owning large recruiter portfolios and driving new partnerships, repeat engagement, and even leading B2B initiatives.



 These are starting thoughts, of course, and any decision on a role is always a function of what a person wants matched with what the organization can offer at that time. The great advantage of a company that’s growing well (like Kraftshala) is that new opportunities open up frequently, and our preference would always be to try to fill up newly created roles with candidates from within the organization.
 



  





**Must\-Haves:**



* 0\-2 years of prior experience in process management, relationship building, operations, or similar customer\-facing roles (We’re not fussed about the exact years of experience, as that’s just a proxy for your skill level.)
* Prior experience managing career services, placements, or corporate relations in an education institution would be a big plus



  





**Top Grading:**




  





 We’re looking for someone who doesn't wait around for instructions to get started. Our A\-Players are those who take initiative \- they build relationships with all stakeholders, spot gaps early, and design solutions proactively. They are the ones who take full ownership of the student and recruiter experience, staying a few steps ahead of any possible issues.
 



  





 A B\-Player, on the other hand, might wait for work to be assigned or limit themselves to what's been explicitly stated. They may execute tasks well, but aren't thinking beyond what's in front of them \- which doesn't quite cut it in a high\-ownership, high\-trust team like ours.
 



  





**Recruitment Process:**




  





 As a small team, we must get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30\-60 minutes, and will be a mix of online and in\-person interactions.
 


* **Conversation 1:** 
 This will be a virtual call with the HR team to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process to set expectations about what you’re signing up for
* **Technical Exercise:** 
 This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role
* **Conversation 2:** 
 This will be a detailed assessment review conversation with the Operations team to go over your submission for the technical exercise.
* **Conversation 3:** 
 This will be a conversation where you can expect to be further evaluated on the competencies needed for the job (mentioned above).
* **Conversation 4:** 
 A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode (read below about it).
* **Extending an offer:** 
 If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.



  





**Location:**




 Gurugram
 



  





 Know more about Kraftshala’s philosophy, culture and investors here.

The incumbent will be responsible for developing and executing talent acquisition strategies to attract, assess, and hire high\-caliber talent across manufacturing plants, engineering functions, supply chain, operations, quality, projects, R\&D, corporate functions, and leadership positions across India and international markets.
 



 The ideal candidate should possess extensive experience in hiring for global manufacturing organizations and demonstrate expertise in workforce planning, stakeholder management, talent mapping, employer branding, recruitment analytics, and building high\-performing recruitment teams. The role will have significant responsibility for international talent acquisition, cross\-border hiring, global talent mapping, and engagement with talent markets across regions such as the Middle East, Europe, APAC, Africa, and North America.

**Talent Acquisition Strategy \& Workforce Planning**

* Build proactive talent pipelines for niche engineering, technical, operational, and leadership positions across global talent markets.
* Develop market\-specific recruitment strategies based on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, hiring practices, and local market dynamics.



**Global \& International Talent Acquisition** 



* Lead end\-to\-end international recruitment initiatives across multiple geographies and talent markets.
* Manage hiring mandates for overseas locations and support the organization’s international expansion and global workforce requirements.
* Develop and execute sourcing strategies to identify talent from international markets for specialized, technical, leadership, and critical business roles.
* Build and maintain talent pools across regions including Middle East, Europe, APAC, Africa, North America, and other relevant international markets.
* Partner with international recruitment consultants, executive search firms, agencies, professional networks, and industry associations to support global hiring.
* Manage cross\-border recruitment processes while ensuring alignment with applicable hiring practices, documentation requirements, and organizational policies.
* Develop market intelligence on international talent availability, compensation benchmarks, competitor hiring trends, and talent movement.
* Drive passive candidate engagement and international talent mapping for critical and hard\-to\-fill positions.
* Support relocation and international mobility requirements associated with overseas hiring, in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders.



**Global Manufacturing Recruitment** 



* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for manufacturing, operations, engineering, maintenance, projects, quality, procurement, supply chain, EHS, R\&D, and corporate functions.
* Manage hiring requirements across domestic and international manufacturing locations.
* Develop sourcing strategies for hard\-to\-fill and niche manufacturing roles across local and global talent markets.
* Ensure quality hiring while meeting recruitment timelines and business expectations.
* Support greenfield, brownfield, capacity expansion, and international expansion hiring projects.



**Leadership Hiring \& Talent Mapping** 



* Lead recruitment for senior management and leadership positions across manufacturing and corporate functions, including international mandates.
* Conduct market intelligence, competitor mapping, and talent benchmarking exercises across domestic and international markets.
* Build relationships with industry professionals, consultants, executive search partners, and global talent networks.
* Maintain talent pipelines for succession and future business requirements across geographies.



**Stakeholder Management** 



* Partner closely with business leaders, plant heads, functional leaders, and international stakeholders to understand organizational talent needs.
* Provide market insights on domestic and international talent availability, compensation trends, competitor hiring activities, and market dynamics.
* Conduct periodic hiring reviews with leadership teams and present recruitment dashboards and talent market insights.
* Influence hiring decisions through data\-driven recommendations and talent market intelligence.



**Recruitment Operations \& Process Excellence** 



* Establish robust recruitment processes, governance frameworks, and SOPs for domestic and international hiring.
* Drive ATS adoption, recruitment automation, and process optimization initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies, diversity goals, and hiring standards across relevant geographies.
* Monitor and improve key recruitment metrics including:
* Time to Hire

* Offer Acceptance Ratio
* Source Effectiveness
* Quality of Hire
* Hiring Manager Satisfaction

**Employer Branding \& Talent Engagement**

* Drive employer branding initiatives through social media, industry forums, professional networks, and campus engagement.
* Build strategic partnerships with engineering institutes, technical universities, industry associations, and international talent networks.
* Develop initiatives to enhance the organization's visibility as an employer across global talent markets.
* Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle, including international candidates.



**Team Leadership** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop the Talent Acquisition team supporting domestic and international hiring.
* Establish performance metrics and accountability frameworks for the recruitment team.
* Build sourcing and assessment capabilities through coaching and training.
* Develop the team's capability to manage global sourcing, international recruitment, and cross\-border hiring mandates.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and high\-performance recruiting.



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong expertise in Talent Acquisition Strategy and Workforce Planning.
* Proven experience in hiring for global manufacturing, engineering, operations, supply chain, and leadership functions.
* Strong understanding of international talent markets and global recruitment practices.
* Proven experience managing international / cross\-border hiring mandates will be strongly preferred.
* Expertise in talent mapping, executive search, and passive candidate engagement across domestic and international markets.
* Strong stakeholder management and business partnering skills across multiple geographies.
* Strong recruitment analytics and data\-driven decision\-making capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience with ATS platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, and social recruiting.
* Strong negotiation, influencing, and communication skills.

**Qualifications**

* Exposure to international recruitment agencies, executive search firms, global sourcing platforms, and cross\-border hiring processes will be preferred.

title: Account Management Associate
description:
**The short version:**




  





**Who we’re looking for:** 
 People who are great at building relationships and keeping things moving. You’re probably the one who remembers every deadline, checks in with everyone, and somehow manages to keep it all together when things get hectic. If you’re someone who enjoys working with people, balancing multiple priorities, and seeing plans turn into results, you’ll fit right in here.
 



  





**What this role is about:** 
 You’ll work with our recruiter partners \- the companies that hire from Kraftshala \- to make their hiring experience seamless. From setting up placement drives and coordinating with internal teams to solving last\-minute challenges, you’ll be the bridge that keeps everything connected and running smoothly.
 



  





**Why you should apply:** 
 This is a role where you’ll see your work translate into real outcomes \- recruiters finding the right talent and students landing their first jobs. You’ll sharpen your communication, problem\-solving, and relationship\-management skills \- the kind that’ll set you up for any leadership or business role in the future. And the cherry on top? You’ll get to build a network that most people only dream of \- working directly with the top leadership of some of India’s best brands and marketing agencies.
 



  





**About us:** 
 Kraftshala is India's largest skilling institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate overall and a 100% placement rate in our sales programs, and we are gunning to become the world's largest career launchpad, across domains.
 



  





 We're backed by a number of eminent investors including ex\-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.
 



  





**The detailed version:**




  





 One of the biggest reasons students choose Kraftshala is our strong placement outcomes, and one of the biggest reasons companies continue to hire from Kraftshala is our track record of seamless execution, strong candidate quality, and consistent recruiter experience \- and that’s exactly why the Recruiter Partnerships (Account Management) team is such a critical part of the organization.
 



  





**Primary Responsibilities will include:** 




  





***Placement Operations***



* Managing end\-to\-end placement drives for assigned recruiter accounts, ensuring timelines and quality standards are consistently met
* Planning and executing placement logistics \- interview schedules, assessments, candidate lists \- in close coordination with hiring teams and internal stakeholders
* Serving as the primary point of contact for recruiters during the placement cycle, ensuring proactive communication and prompt resolution of queries
* Collaborating with student\-facing and operations teams to ensure students are well\-prepared and responsive throughout the process
* Tracking and analyzing performance data (e.g. interview conversion rates, recruiter feedback) to identify trends and improvement areas
* Identifying opportunities to grow and retain recruiter relationships through consistent delivery and trust\-building



  





***Process Optimization***




 Every delayed email, broken link, or missed follow\-up can erode trust \- and in placements, trust is everything. That’s why we’re constantly refining the way we operate, and hence, you’d be:
 


* Utilizing an array of tools, softwares, and platforms to automate processes in order to minimize human intervention and ensuring a flawless and effortless delivery of our placement cycles.
* Facilitating seamless collaboration with the product team to introduce innovative platform features and enhance operational efficiency.



  





**Monthly Outcomes:**



* **Month 1:** 
 Understand all current placement processes, tools, and workflows. Assist in 2\-3 drives and begin managing recruiter and student interactions.
* **Month 2:** 
 Run 3\-4 recruiter accounts independently with 90%\+ student participation and \<24hr query response time. Identify 3\-5 process gaps.
* **Month 3\+:** 
 Implement at least 2 process improvements. Maintain Recruiter and Student NPS. Drive at least one automation initiative.



  





***A question we’d like to address upfront is what the career trajectory looks like for someone in this role.***




  





 At Kraftshala, operations are central to how we serve our stakeholders. You'll start by learning the craft of partnerships and account management through hands\-on placement execution. Over time, two broad paths could open up:
 


* If your strengths lie in scaling processes, systems thinking, and managing cross\-functional execution, you could lead placement operations \- shaping how we deliver outcomes to recruiters and students at scale.
* If you love building and growing relationships, you could transition into owning large recruiter portfolios and driving new partnerships, repeat engagement, and even leading B2B initiatives.



 These are starting thoughts, of course, and any decision on a role is always a function of what a person wants matched with what the organization can offer at that time. The great advantage of a company that’s growing well (like Kraftshala) is that new opportunities open up frequently, and our preference would always be to try to fill up newly created roles with candidates from within the organization.
 



  





**Must\-Haves:**



* 0\-2 years of prior experience in process management, relationship building, operations, or similar customer\-facing roles (We’re not fussed about the exact years of experience, as that’s just a proxy for your skill level.)
* Prior experience managing career services, placements, or corporate relations in an education institution would be a big plus



  





**Top Grading:**




  





 We’re looking for someone who doesn't wait around for instructions to get started. Our A\-Players are those who take initiative \- they build relationships with all stakeholders, spot gaps early, and design solutions proactively. They are the ones who take full ownership of the student and recruiter experience, staying a few steps ahead of any possible issues.
 



  





 A B\-Player, on the other hand, might wait for work to be assigned or limit themselves to what's been explicitly stated. They may execute tasks well, but aren't thinking beyond what's in front of them \- which doesn't quite cut it in a high\-ownership, high\-trust team like ours.
 



  





**Recruitment Process:**




  





 As a small team, we must get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30\-60 minutes, and will be a mix of online and in\-person interactions.
 


* **Conversation 1:** 
 This will be a virtual call with the HR team to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process to set expectations about what you’re signing up for
* **Technical Exercise:** 
 This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role
* **Conversation 2:** 
 This will be a detailed assessment review conversation with the Operations team to go over your submission for the technical exercise.
* **Conversation 3:** 
 This will be a conversation where you can expect to be further evaluated on the competencies needed for the job (mentioned above).
* **Conversation 4:** 
 A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode (read below about it).
* **Extending an offer:** 
 If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.



  





**Location:**




 Gurugram
 



  





 Know more about Kraftshala’s philosophy, culture and investors here.

description:
**About Amplify Health**




**Who We Are** 




 Amplify Health is Asia’s leading health technology and analytics organisation, providing our customers with integrated solutions to make healthcare more accessible, affordable and effective across the region.
 



  





 We offer a unique B2B business model and integrated stack of SaaS\-based products, PaaS\-based HealthTech launchpad and DaaS\-based on\-demand data offerings to deliver impact to our customers across the healthcare value\-chain.
 



  





 Our joint\-venture partners, AIA and Discovery, have provided us with the foundations and a platform that truly differentiates us from our competitors and allows us to build and deploy products at a scale and quality that few can match.
 



  





 We aim to be the trusted custodian of Asia's largest repository of health data, unifying financial, clinical, operational and behavioural data to empower our customers with insights that highlight opportunities to deliver better value and care outcomes.
 



  





**Our Vision and Ambition** 




 To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.
 



 Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value\-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.
 



 By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health\-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.
 



  





**The Position**




**Summary** 




 As a Provider Management Specialist, the role is a specialist advisor position supporting private health insurers to improve their claims risk management, primarily through provider contracting strategy, panel optimisation, patient pathway design, and insurance product alignment.
 



 You will work directly with client teams, enabling them to build stronger provider networks, negotiate effectively, utilise data insights, and apply best‑practice provider management strategies within the healthcare and HealthTech ecosystem.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\) On‑Site Client Advisory \& Provider Management Support** 



* Serves as the primary advisor to senior insurer stakeholders to drive and support provider management targets, initiatives and implementations, including, supporting strategic initiatives, contracting cycles, and provider engagement plans.
* Shapes multi‑year provider strategy, including contracting redesign and ecosystem partnerships.
* Develop high‑quality materials for client prep sessions, executive updates, and provider negotiations, ensuring clarity, coherence and insight‑driven storytelling.
* Serve as an embedded advisor supporting the client’s operational and strategic objectives.



**2\) Internal Provider Analytics Product Development** 



* Translate key client needs, pain points, and market insights into product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback to evolve Amplify Health’s provider analytics tools, dashboards and negotiation support solutions.
* Acts as the thought partner to product leadership for long‑term roadmap development.



**3\) Capability Building and Upskilling Client Teams** 



* Identify and prioritize key knowledge gaps and design tailored workshops, demos and training modules to upskill capabilities across client teams.
* Run coaching and role‑play sessions to elevate client teams’ provider negotiation capabilities and commercial acumen to improve negotiations for provider engagements.



  





**Candidate Profile**




**Experience and Qualifications** 



* Over 6 years experience in health insurance, health\-related industries or consulting.
* Demonstrated success in managing cost efficiencies in healthcare, whether at providers, insurers or population health level.
* Proven experience in client advisory work particularly in healthcare related work.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA or relevant) strongly preferred.



  





**Competencies \& Core Characteristics:** 




 We are seeking a leader who embodies the following competencies and characteristics essential for success in our scale\-up environment:
 


* **Strategic Architect:** 
 Able to connect disparate information into a cohesive strategy leveraging Amplify Health frameworks. Capable of designing clear, actionable paths for clients navigating complex provider ecosystems.
* **Data\-Driven Decisiveness:** 
 Confidence in working with data, identifying insights, and translating analytics into compelling narratives. Ensures objective, evidence‑based decision‑making in provider negotiations and strategy formulation.
* **Customer‑Obsessed Advocate:** 
 Anticipates client needs and proactively delivers value through insights, structure and advisory support.
* **Resilient Operator:** 
 able to operate in a fluid and changing start\-up environment, flexing between internal work and client facing modes
* **Unifier \& Cross\-Functional Influencer:** 
 Collaborates seamlessly across clinical, analytics, commercial and product teams. Drives alignment and shared understanding between stakeholders.

title: Asset Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




  





**Manage the complete banking requirements of SME and corporate clients, including working capital, term loans, trade finance, foreign exchange, cash management, transaction banking and liability products, while identifying opportunities for cross\-selling and deepening client relationships.** 




 The candidate will be responsible for sourcing, advising and managing business banking relationships across working capital, trade finance, term lending, supply chain finance, export finance, business\-purpose mortgages, and insurance cross\-sell \- syndicated across BlissMoney’s panel of banks and NBFCs.
 



**1\. Products \& Services You Will Manage** 




  





**1\.1   Working Capital Finance** 




 ·       Cash Credit, Overdraft, Working Capital Demand Loans (WCDL), Dropline Overdraft, Short\-term loans and ad\-hoc limits
 



**1\.2   Trade Finance** 




 ·       Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees, Bill Discounting, Buyer’s Credit, Supplier’s Credit, Packing Credit, Post\-Shipment Finance, Export Bill Negotiation, Import Finance, Supply Chain Finance
 



**1\.3   Term Lending** 




 ·       Business Loans, Machinery / Equipment Finance, Commercial Property Loans, Capex Funding
 



**1\.4   Supply Chain \& Receivables Finance** 




 ·       Dealer Finance, Vendor Finance, Invoice Discounting, Factoring, Channel Finance
 



**1\.5 Export \& International Trade Finance** 





 ·       
 
**FCNR Funding:** 

 foreign\-currency funding sourced against FCNR(B) deposit\-linked facilities.
 





 ·       
 
**PCFC (Packing Credit in Foreign Currency):** 

 pre\-shipment export finance in foreign currency, complementing rupee\-denominated Packing Credit above.
 





 ·       
 
**EEFC Account\-Linked Facilities:** 

 supporting exporters who retain a portion of earnings in foreign currency.
 





 ·       
 
**Forfaiting:** 

 non\-recourse purchase of export receivables, distinct from and complementary to factoring.
 





 ·       
 
**Standby Letters of Credit (SBLC):** 

 for clients with cross\-border trade or contractual guarantee requirements.
 





 ·       
 
**External Commercial Borrowings (ECB) Facilitation:** 

 for larger export/import\-oriented clients seeking foreign currency term funding.
 




 ·       
 **ECGC\-Backed Export Credit Insurance:** 

 insurance
 
 \-supported export credit for clients trading in higher\-risk markets.
 



**1\.6 Business\-Purpose Mortgages** 




 ·       Loan Against Property (LAP) \- primarily for business owners raising capital against commercial or personal property.
 



**1\.7 Insurance Cross\-Sell** 





 ·       
 
**Loan Protection Insurance:** 

 bundled with any loan closed, tying directly into BlissMoney’s existing insurance services.
 





 ·       
 
**MSME / SME Insurance Products:** 

 broader business insurance \- property, liability, and other MSME\-relevant covers \- offered as a cross\-sell alongside lending, not limited to loan protection alone.
 




**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




  





**2\.1 Sourcing Business Banking Relationships** 




 ·       Build a pipeline of SME and corporate clients across working capital, trade finance, term lending and export finance needs \- leveraging existing banking relationships plus BlissMoney’s referral network.
 



 ·       Work leads handed over by the Wealth/RM team and existing client base.
 



**2\.2 Credit Assessment \& Structuring** 




 ·       Assess each client’s working capital cycle, trade flows, and credit need \- structuring a proposal a lender will actually approve.
 



 ·       For trade finance specifically: correctly structure LC, BG and documentary credit requirements, with working knowledge of INCOTERMS and export/import documentation.
 



**2\.3 Syndication \& Placement** 




 ·       Place the structured requirement with the right lender from BlissMoney’s panel of banks/NBFCs, based on rate, turnaround time, and eligibility fit.
 



 ·       For larger or foreign\-currency requirements, structure the facility across more than one lender where needed \- true syndication, not just referral.
 



**2\.4 Lender \& Partner Relationship Management** 




 ·       Build and maintain relationships with banks and NBFCs to secure competitive terms and faster turnaround for BlissMoney clients, across both lending and deposit\-side referrals.
 



**2\.5 Cross\-Sell \& Internal Coordination** 




 ·       Work closely with RMs and the Advisory team to identify banking and insurance cross\-sell opportunities within BlissMoney’s existing client base.
 



 ·       Keep the Advisory team informed when a client takes on new business debt, since it affects their overall financial picture.
 



**2\.6 Compliance \& Documentation** 




 ·       
 **DSA Registration:** 
 BlissMoney operates as a facilitator, partnered with banks and NBFC institutions. This role \- or BlissMoney as an entity \- will be registered as a Direct Selling Agent (DSA) with each partner lender.
 



 ·       Follow RBI and FEMA guidelines on loan sourcing, fair practices and cross\-border trade transactions at every stage. Maintain complete, audit\-ready documentation for every case, including export/import documentation where applicable.
 



**3\. What We’re Looking For** 




  






 ·       
 
**Primary Fit:** 
 currently or previously a Relationship Manager in a bank’s Business Banking Group (BBG), Small \& Business Banking (SBB), Mid\-Enterprise Group (MEG), or Corporate/Trade Finance desk \- or an equivalent business banking role at another bank or NBFC.
 




 ·       
 
 Genuine comfort assessing business credit and trade finance requirements \- reading financial statements, understanding working capital cycles, and structuring proposals across both rupee and foreign\-currency facilities.
 




 ·       
 
 Working knowledge of export/import documentation, RBI/FEMA guidelines governing trade finance and cross\-border transactions.
 




 ·       
 
 Comfort managing a full cycle independently \- from sourcing through structuring to closing \- without a separate handover to another closer.
 




 ·       
 
 Existing relationships with banks/NBFCs and business\-owner clients are a strong advantage, given the target candidate profile above.
 




 ·       
 
 Clear, honest communication \- business banking is a trust\-sensitive relationship, and clients need someone who explains terms plainly, not someone who oversells.

description:

**Main Duties \& Scope of the role** 




 The Strategic Alliance Manager is responsible for driving hyperlocal brand visibility, institutional engagement, and student lead generation for StudyIn within their assigned territory.  The ideal candidate is a high\-energy, execution\-focused professional who excels at building relationships with schools, colleges, and coaching centers, whilst seamlessly managing community events and B2B partner engagement to boost student walk\-ins and applications.

**3\. Hyperlocal Marketing Execution**

 Support local promotions and tactical activations to increase walk\-ins (e.g., experiential pop\-ups and student networking sessions).

 Act as the social media champion for the local branch, capturing high\-quality content and student testimonials during events for digital amplification.



**4\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Reporting**

description:
Senior – School Partnerships \-AIQ (https://dreamtimeaiq.com)

 We are looking for a Senior – School Partnerships professional who understands the Indian school ecosystem and can build trusted relationships with school owners, trustees, principals, academic heads and education leaders.
 



  





 This is a consultative business development and sales role. The successful candidate will combine education expertise, relationship\-building, storytelling and commercial ability to engage schools, understand their needs and create opportunities for meaningful AI\-led transformation.

 \* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

 Storytelling \& Stakeholder Engagement
 



  





 \* Present ideas around the future of education, AI and school transformation in a simple, compelling and relatable way.

 \* Develop relationships with education communities, associations and influential stakeholders.
 



 \* Track market trends, competitor activity and changing school priorities.
 



 \* Identify new markets and partnership opportunities.
 



  





 Voice of the School
 



  





 \* Understand the real needs and challenges of schools.
 



 \* Capture market feedback and share insights with Academic, Product, Marketing and Leadership teams.
 



 \* Help shape how Dreamtime Learning communicates its value to schools.
 



 \* Identify emerging needs that can influence future offerings and engagement strategies.
 



  





 Key Result Indicators (KRIs)
 



  





 Performance will be measured across commercial growth, relationship development and school engagement.
 



  





 Commercial KRIs
 



  





 \* Achievement of monthly and quarterly revenue / business targets.
 



 \* Number and value of qualified opportunities generated.
 



 \* Sales pipeline development and pipeline coverage.
 



 \* Number of school meetings and qualified stakeholder conversations.
 



 \* Presentation and demonstration\-to\-opportunity conversion.
 



 \* Proposal\-to\-closure conversion rate.
 



 \* Number of new institutional partnerships closed.
 



 \* Revenue generated from new and existing partnerships.
 



  





 Relationship KRIs
 



  





 \* Growth and quality of the school network.
 



 \* Number of senior\-level relationships established.
 



 \* Engagement with school owners, trustees, principals and academic heads.
 



 \* Referrals and opportunities generated through existing relationships.
 



 \* Participation and engagement in key education forums and networks.
 



  





 Engagement \& Adoption KRIs
 



  





 \* Workshops and school leadership sessions conducted.
 



 \* Quality of stakeholder engagement.
 



 \* Successful transition of partnerships from sales to implementation.
 



 \* Expansion opportunities within existing school relationships.
 



 \* Partner satisfaction and relationship health.
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  





 We are looking for someone who combines education credibility, storytelling ability and commercial drive.
 



  





 Essential
 



  





 \* 5\+ years of experience in the K\-12 ecosystem — EdTech, publishing, curriculum, school leadership, education services, technology or related sectors.
 



 \* Strong understanding of the Indian school ecosystem.
 



 \* Existing relationships with school owners, principals, trustees or academic leaders will be highly valued.
 



 \* Excellent communication, presentation and storytelling skills.
 



 \* Strong consultative selling and business development capability.
 



 \* Confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
 



 \* Ability to understand needs, influence decisions and close opportunities.
 



 \* Good understanding of pedagogy, curriculum, school operations and technology adoption.
 



 \* Willingness to travel extensively across India.
 



 \* Strong digital awareness and willingness to learn about AI and emerging technologies.
 



 \* Laptop mandatory.
 



  





 The Person We Are Looking For
 



  





 You could be an education professional, curriculum leader, EdTech professional, school solutions specialist, consultant, institutional sales professional or school leader.
 



  





 More importantly, you are:
 



  





 A Storyteller
 



 You can take an idea and make people see its possibility.
 



  





 A Relationship Builder
 



 People trust you and are willing to open doors for you.
 



  





 A Consultative Seller
 



 You listen first, understand the problem and then create the right proposition.
 



  





 A Commercial Thinker
 



 You understand that relationships must ultimately translate into opportunities, partnerships and revenue.
 



  





 An Education Insider
 



 You understand how schools operate, how decisions are made and what matters to education leaders.
 



  





 An AI \& Innovation Enthusiast
 



 You are curious about how AI and emerging technologies can reshape education and can communicate these possibilities to non\-technical audiences.
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 The successful person will become a trusted education advisor and a strong commercial representative of Dreamtime Learning — someone who can open doors, create meaningful conversations, build conviction, and ultimately turn those relationships into successful school partnerships.
 



  





 If you can build the relationship, tell the story, create the opportunity and close the partnership — we want to hear from you.

 As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:

**The team**
 Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology\-enabled, cutting\-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co\-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
   

  

 TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
   

  

 Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) \- Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading\-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
   

  

 Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co\-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.

 AI \& Digital Transformation Initiatives
 



  




* Collaborate with product and data teams to implement AI\-powered features such as:
* Intelligent invoice processing and automation
* Predictive spend analytics and insights
* Supplier risk scoring and recommendation engines
* Identify opportunities to embed AI/ML into procurement workflows to improve efficiency and decision\-making.
* Drive adoption of automation, chatbots, and AI assistants within procurement processes.
* Analyze client data to recommend data\-driven optimizations and process improvements.
* Contribute to defining AI use cases, solution design, and value realization frameworks.
* Stay current with advancements in AI, GenAI, and automation within procurement and enterprise SaaS.



  





 Collaboration \& Leadership
 



  




* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including Product, Engineering, and Project Management.

**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





 Education
 



  




* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field.



  





 Experience
 



  




* 6–10 years of experience in SaaS implementation, preferably in procurement or supply chain solutions.
* Strong expertise in S2P and P2P processes.
* Hands\-on experience with any one of these platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Jaggaer, Basware, or similar.
* Proven experience in system configuration, customization, and ERP integrations.
* Exposure to APIs, data integration, and cloud technologies.



  





 Preferred Skills
 


* Experience working with AI/ML\-enabled enterprise applications or automation tools.
* Understanding of data analytics, reporting, and visualization tools.
* Familiarity with Agile/Waterfall project methodologies.
* Strong problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

 Location: Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune

* Work with leading global enterprises to drive digital and AI\-led procurement transformation.

* Opportunity to shape next\-generation intelligent procurement solutions.

You will be directly responsible for eliminating project bottlenecks—ensuring that every residential project clears financing, approvals, procurement, dispatch, and final grid synchronization without delays or paperwork friction.

 Practical working knowledge in complex processes, typically involving multiple external agencies/portals. Ability to assess process flows and make changes. Ability to root\-cause situations that arise in day to day project flows.
* **Problem Solver**

**What We Offer** 



* Competitive fixed compensation structure.
* Performance bonuses linked to operational velocity, turnaround times, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* A high\-impact role driving the core operational backbone of a fast\-growing residential clean\-tech business.

**About You**

* Experience supporting high\-level executives.

* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with professionals at all levels.

**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive.  We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

 Job Summary As a Senior Technical Support Engineer for Focused Services, you will deliver a personalized customer experience to ensure the successful adoption and operation of Palo Alto Networks products. You will develop a strategic partnership with customers and their Technical Account Manager to mitigate risks, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and provide proactive guidance. In this role, you will provide escalation management for critical technical issues, acting as a virtual member of the customer's team to accelerate their time to value. Key Responsibilities Provide reactive and proactive technical support, including configuration reviews and best practice guidance, to a dedicated portfolio of high\-value customers. Manage and prioritize support cases effectively, ensuring all issues are meticulously recorded, tracked, and resolved in a timely manner. Perform advanced fault isolation and root cause analysis for complex, multi\-faceted technical issues across diverse network environments. Proactively collaborate with internal teams, including development, to reproduce customer issues and drive resolutions for complex problems. Develop and publish technical documentation, such as support bulletins and knowledge base articles, to simplify complex topics for customers and internal teams. Maintain secure, detailed, and customer\-specific documentation to streamline current and future troubleshooting efforts. Travel to customer sites as required to partner with Technical Account Managers and provide hands\-on support for key accounts.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications 5\+ years of experience in a client\-facing technical support, network engineering, or systems engineering role. Demonstrated experience with TCP/IP and advanced routing \& switching protocols (e.g., OSPF, BGP, VLAN, STP). Hands\-on experience with Palo Alto Networks products and technologies. Proven ability to independently debug broad, complex, and unique networks with mixed media and protocols. Flexibility to work non\-standard shift hours as required, including afternoons, evenings, and weekends. Preferred Qualifications Experience with authentication protocols such as RADIUS and TACACS\+. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical issues to both technical and non\-technical audiences. Experience summarizing critical situations and presenting technical findings to senior stakeholders

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
**Overview**
 Job Description
   

  

**Department:**
 Business Technology – Atlassian Products
   

  

**Reports To:**
 Manager, Atlassian Products
   

  

**Location:**
 India (On\-site) – Bangalore
   

  

**Level:**
 Individual Contributor – Entry/Mid
   

  

**About HealthEdge**
 HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud\-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale – and Atlassian is at the center of how work gets done across the organization.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Atlassian Administrator is a hands\-on platform administration role responsible for the day\-to\-day configuration, maintenance, and user support of HealthEdge's Atlassian environment, including Jira Software, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence. Working within the Atlassian Products team and reporting to the Manager, Atlassian Products, you will be a key execution resource for platform requests, project configuration, user management, and basic automation – ensuring that thousands of users across the organization can work effectively in Atlassian tools every day.
   

  

 This is a great role for someone with solid Atlassian fundamentals who wants to deepen their platform expertise in a complex, high\-scale environment. You'll work closely with Senior Atlassian Administrators, Architects, and the team manager, taking on well\-defined configuration tasks and growing toward more advanced solution design and automation work over time. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, this role will grow to include working with AI\-native features like Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo — making content governance and platform hygiene directly connected to AI quality.
   

  

**What You'll Do** 
**Platform Administration \& Configuration**
* Administer Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence in a cloud environment
* Create and maintain Jira projects, boards, workflows, permission schemes, notification schemes, and screens under the guidance of senior team members
* Configure and manage JSM service desk projects including request types, queues, SLA configurations, and portal settings
* Manage Confluence spaces, page permissions, templates, and basic macros to support team knowledge management
* Perform user and group management including account creation, license assignments, group membership, and access reviews
* Process and fulfill Atlassian support requests from end users, maintaining SLA compliance in the team's JSM queue


**Automation \& Reporting**
* Build and maintain native Jira and JSM automation rules for common workflows – ticket routing, notifications, field updates, and status transitions
* Create and maintain dashboards, saved filters, and basic reports to support team and stakeholder visibility
* Assist with Confluence automation and page template maintenance
* Support testing and rollout of automation changes developed by Senior Administrators


**User Support \& Enablement**
* Serve as a first point of contact for Atlassian support requests, resolving common configuration and usage questions
* Escalate complex or high\-impact issues to Senior Atlassian Administrators with clear documentation and context
* Assist in onboarding new users and teams to Atlassian tools, including basic training and guidance on project setup
* Contribute to and maintain Atlassian knowledge base articles and how\-to documentation for end users


**Governance \& Housekeeping**
* Perform routine platform hygiene tasks including inactive user cleanup, stale project reviews, and unused field or scheme audits
* Assist with license usage tracking and reporting to support renewal planning
* Follow and help enforce Atlassian governance standards for project naming, permissions, and configuration consistency
* Support audit and compliance activities related to Atlassian access and configuration


**Project \& Team Support**
* Assist Senior Administrators and the team manager with larger configuration projects, migrations, and platform improvement initiatives
* Participate in testing and validation of Atlassian upgrades, app changes, and configuration rollouts
* Document changes accurately in accordance with team change management practices


**What You'll Bring** 
**Required**
* 2–4 years of hands\-on Jira and/or Confluence administration experience in a corporate environment
* Working knowledge of Jira Software project types, workflows, permission schemes, and issue configuration
* Experience configuring and supporting Jira Service Management (JSM) service desk projects
* Familiarity with Confluence space administration, page permissions, and content organization
* Experience with native Jira automation rules
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills – platform hygiene and accuracy matter in this role
* Good written and verbal English communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent requests and prioritize effectively


**Preferred**
* Experience with Atlassian Cloud (vs. Data Center/Server only)
* Atlassian certification (ACP\-120 Jira Administration or equivalent)
* Familiarity with Atlassian Marketplace apps (ScriptRunner, Elements Connect, or similar)
* Familiarity with Atlassian Intelligence or Rovo
* Exposure to ITIL frameworks or service management best practices
* Basic scripting or REST API exposure (not required, but a strong differentiator)
* Experience working in a global, multi\-time zone organization


**What Success Looks Like**
 Within 90 days, you are independently handling the majority of day\-to\-day Atlassian support requests, have a solid working knowledge of HealthEdge's project and space structure, and are contributing to platform hygiene initiatives. Within six months, you are building and maintaining automation rules confidently, your queue work is consistently within SLA, and stakeholders are getting reliable, well\-configured solutions from you. Within a year, you have grown your platform depth meaningfully, are contributing to larger configuration projects, and are beginning to take on more complex solution design work with senior team support.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You'll join a dedicated Atlassian Products team within Business Technology, focused on making Jira, JSM, and Confluence work well for thousands of users across a complex global organization. The team values platform rigor, clean governance, and user\-focused solutions – and invests in growing the skills of everyone on it. This role is an excellent entry point into a team where strong administrators can grow into senior and lead positions over time.
   

  

**Geographic Responsibility: This position is located in Bangalore**
**Type of Employment: Full\-time, permanent**
**FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt**
**Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:**
* The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
* Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
* Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
* May require travel dependent on company needs.


 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990\. Candidates may be required to go through a pre\-employment criminal background check.
   

  

 HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

description:

***worldwide***
