description:
**Overview**
 Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Atlanta, Trimont (www.trimont.com) is a specialized global commercial real estate loan services provider and partner for lenders seeking the infrastructure and capabilities needed to make informed, effective decisions related to the deployment, management and administration of commercial real estate secured credit.
   

  

 We do this with a team of 1100\+ extraordinary Team Members who serve a global client base from offices in Atlanta, Bengaluru, Charlotte, Dallas, Hyderabad, Kansas City, London, New York and Sydney. We empower our skilled global teams by equipping them with the necessary knowledge and advanced technology, as well as fostering a culture driven by values. This approach helps our teams excel and build meaningful client relationships, while providing the highest quality service and feeling proud of the work they do.
   

  

 Trimont is an innovative firm where visionary professionals come to learn, grow, and thrive with colleagues driven by curiosity and collaboration.
   

  

**Learn:** 
 We believe ongoing learning is critical and are focused on providing a work environment where all team members can take ownership of their careers.
   

  

**Grow:** 
 We work alongside the largest institutional lenders in the world, overseeing the most significant projects in the industry. This unique opportunity allows us to broaden our skillset and develop our abilities by tackling some of the industry's most challenging and exciting endeavors.
   

  

**Thrive:** 
 Our firm is a place where ethics and excellence meet to create an experience that matches our capabilities. There are no limits to what we as team members as an organization, can achieve together.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 This position is responsible for managing end\-to\-end process for construction draw requests, including receipt, initial review, documentation verification, and coordination with borrowers, lenders, and consultants to ensure timely and compliant funding. Skilled in reviewing draw packages for completeness and accuracy, ensuring all required documentation (draw request forms, invoices, proof of payment, conditional and unconditional lien waivers) meets contractual and regulatory standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* To process various loan servicing activities/inquiries/requests adhering to laid down procedures and ensuring that the established service standards are met
* Draw Request Lifecycle Management: Proven ability to manage the end\-to\-end process for construction draw requests, including receipt, initial review, documentation verification, and coordination with borrowers, lenders, and consultants to ensure timely and compliant funding.
* Document Review \& Compliance: Skilled in reviewing draw packages for completeness and accuracy, ensuring all required documentation (draw request forms, invoices, proof of payment, conditional and unconditional lien waivers) meets contractual and regulatory standards.
* Tracker \& Workflow Administration: Experience in setting up and maintaining draw trackers, invoice logs, and open items lists to monitor draw status, budget revisions, and outstanding documentation. Proficiency with digital workflow tools and shared drives for document management.
* Budget \& Contract Reconciliation: Ability to reconcile draw requests against project budgets and contract documents (including AIA forms G702/G703\), review and document change orders and ensure all funding aligns with approved project scope.
* Invoice \& Payment Verification: Expertise in reviewing invoice backup for relevance, timeliness, and accuracy; confirming invoice totals match requested amounts; and ensuring proper documentation for stored materials (bills of sale, insurance certificates, photos).
* Lien Waiver Administration: Knowledge of state\-specific lien waiver requirements, including collection and verification of signed and notarized waivers from general contractors and subcontractors for each draw cycle.
* Exception \& Issue Resolution: Strong analytical skills to identify and document exceptions, discrepancies, or missing items in draw packages, and communicate effectively with stakeholders to resolve issues within established timelines.
* Consultant \& Title Coordination: Experience working with construction consultants to review monitoring reports and with title companies to secure endorsements prior to funding.
* Stakeholder Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for preparing questions, recommendations, and status updates to asset managers, financial analysts, borrowers, and lenders throughout the draw review process
* Understanding of loan agreements, escrow reserves and commercial real estate operations
* Adherence to the SLA’s – productivity, turn\-around time and accuracy
* Identify potential risk in disbursement and escalate issues as needed
* Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals
* Communicate with borrowers, asset managers and servicing team to facilitate efficient processing of reserve disbursement request
* Contribute to process enhancement to improve efficiency and accuracy in reserve disbursement operations
* Research, respond and resolve complex enquiries and complaints
* Support less experienced loan specialists in providing resolutions for inquiries and complaints
* Serve as subject matter expert and main point of contact for internal teams
* Provide training and guidance on Reserve Disbursement policies and best practices
* Train others in complex loan inquiries and servicing language in loan documentation and interpretation.
* Mentor and support junior team members
* Develop best practices, training material and SOPs to enhance team performance
* Assist in developing and implementing new technologies/systems for reserves disbursement tracking


**Required Qualifications**
* University Masters/bachelor’s degree in business or related discipline.
* 8\+ Years of Loan Servicing experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training and education.
* Reserve Disbursement experience.
* Knowledge of all Mortgage and consumer lending, practices and regulations.
* Sound knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook) skills.
* Ability to interact with all levels of an organization.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills are crucial for engaging with candidates and hiring managers.
* Demonstrated capacity to achieve results in a fast\-paced, high\-volume, and dynamic setting.
* Organizational and administrative skills that reflect attention to detail and the ability to prioritize amidst competing demands.
* Strong work ethic and a sense of urgency.
* Skilled in managing sensitive information while upholding privacy.
* Handling workload and special projects efficiently.
* Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.


 Trimont is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud to support and celebrate diversity in the workplace. title: Senior SME Consolidation
description:
**Job Description**

**Role Summary**
  

 NIQ is seeking a Senior SME – Consolidations to partner with the Global Process Owner (GPO) in managing and continuously improving the global consolidation and close process.
   

  

 This role is instrumental in ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of NIQ’s consolidated financial results, embedding robust governance, automation, and process standardisation across regions.
   

  

 The Senior SME acts as the technical deputy to the GPO, providing operational oversight, subject\-matter guidance, and analytical insights across the consolidation lifecycle. The role will also contribute to NIQ’s broader R2R transformation agenda, supporting initiatives under Project Compass and RTR Quality Board.
   

  

  

  





**Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Consolidation and Reporting**
  

 • Lead execution of monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidations for NIQ entities in OneStream, ensuring accuracy and adherence to close timelines.
   

  

 • Validate consolidation entries, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation adjustments to ensure first\-time\-right financial results.
   

  

 • Partner with Corporate Accounting and Controllership to finalise management and statutory consolidation packs and ensure alignment of group reporting.
   

  

 • Support the GPO in monitoring Close Cockpit milestones and escalation management during close cycles.
   

  





**Governance and Standardisation**
  

 • Maintain and update process documentation, SOPs, and L4 process maps for the consolidation process.
   

  

 • Ensure consistency in consolidation methodologies, data mapping, and chart\-of\-accounts alignment across legal entities.
   

  

 • Support GPO in embedding internal controls (SOX) and ensuring full audit readiness across regions.
   

  

 • Perform process quality reviews and recommend corrective actions for control and reconciliation gaps.
   

  





**Technology and Automation**
  

 • Act as OneStream system SME, supporting configuration changes, system testing, and enhancement requests.
   

  

 • Partner with Enablement and IT to deliver automation and analytics initiatives (RPA, Power BI dashboards, consolidation exception reporting).
   

  

 • Develop and maintain standardised consolidation templates, mapping tables, and validation scripts.
   

  





**Business Partnering and Stakeholder Engagement**
  

 • Liaise with regional controllers, service delivery leads, and corporate accounting teams to ensure smooth consolidation execution and issue resolution.
   

  

 • Provide technical accounting and system support for mergers, acquisitions, and entity restructures.
   

  

 • Collaborate with FP\&A and Corporate Reporting teams to provide insights into consolidated P\&L, balance sheet, and cash flow results.
   

  





**Continuous Improvement and Capability Building**
  

 • Drive root\-cause analysis of consolidation issues and lead remediation actions.
   

  

 • Support GPO in developing and delivering training modules for RTR teams on consolidation best practices.
   

  

 • Contribute to process transformation projects aimed at shortening the close cycle and improving data accuracy.
   

  





**Required Skills and Attributes
   

  

 Core Skills**
  

 • Deep technical expertise in global consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and foreign currency translation.
   

  

 • Strong understanding of end\-to\-end RTR processes, including their interlinkages with FP\&A, Tax, and Controllership.
   

  

 • Hands\-on proficiency in OneStream, Hyperion, or equivalent EPM systems; good knowledge of SAP data structures and ledger logic (0L/1L).
   

  

 • In\-depth knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS, particularly consolidation accounting, equity method, and non\-controlling interests.
   

  

 • Proven experience in managing financial close governance, reconciliation frameworks, and control compliance.
   

  

 • Ability to interpret and communicate complex accounting and system issues clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

  

  





**Behavioural \& Leadership Skills (Modelled on GPO Capabilities)**
  

 • Process Excellence Mindset: Passion for continuous improvement, simplification, and first\-time\-right delivery.
   

  

 • Analytical Rigor: Ability to deep\-dive into data, identify anomalies, and provide actionable insights.
   

  

 • Influence Without Authority: Collaborates effectively across time zones, driving alignment without direct hierarchy.
   

  

 • Execution Discipline: Strong planning, prioritisation, and follow\-through to meet global close deadlines.
   

  

 • Change Agility: Comfortable working in a transformation environment with evolving systems and structures.
   

  

 • Stakeholder Stewardship: Builds trust with Controllers, SDLs, and Corporate Accounting through reliability and responsiveness.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

 • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
   

  

 • Professional qualification (CA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent) preferred.
   

  

 • 10–15 years of experience in Finance Operations, with at least 5 years in consolidation or group reporting.
   

  

 • Prior experience in global consolidation and reporting for multinational organisations is essential.
   

  

 • Exposure to OneStream or Hyperion implementations, process transformation, and automation initiatives desirable.
   

  





**Success Profile**
  

 • Operates as the technical backbone of NIQ’s global consolidation process.
   

  

 • Acts as the operational deputy to the GPO, ensuring process execution excellence and data integrity.
   

  

 • Demonstrates strong technical, analytical, and leadership maturity, preparing for future progression to process\-ownership roles.

 AppZen is an AI\-first automation platform for finance teams, covering the full spend\-to\-pay lifecycle — from invoice processing and expense auditing to accounts payable and corporate card review. Our AI platform integrates with customers' existing systems to reduce manual effort, errors, fraud, and compliance risk, giving finance and accounting teams the tools to operate more strategically and scale without adding headcount.
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 As a member of the Finance team, the Senior Revenue Accountant will own operational revenue accounting and compliance at AppZen.This role reviews, analyzes, and approves customer contracts and revenue arrangements under ASC 606, drives the month\-end revenue close, and partners closely with AR \& Collections, Deal Desk, GTM, and FP\&A to ensure revenue, deferred revenue, and receivable balances are accurate, well\-documented, and audit\-ready. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, motivated, and thrives in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment. This is initially an individual contributor role, with the expectation that it will grow into a managerial position as the Revenue Accounting function scales.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 



 • Manage daily revenue accounting operations — review, analyze, and approve customer contracts using the ASC 606 framework and company policy for revenue recognition.
 



 • Review and approve revenue arrangements for allocations, concessions, and similar items to ensure accurate revenue recognition in compliance with ASC 606\.
 



 • Perform the month\-end revenue close process, including revenue\-related account reconciliations and journal entries for revenue, deferred revenue, and unbilled receivables.
 



 • Perform quarterly CECL aging analysis to ensure consistent application of ASC 326, and partner with the AR \& Collections Lead to develop and report key AR metrics for management reporting.
 



 • Work closely with the AR team to resolve complex AR and collections issues.
 



 • Perform regular month\-end close flux analysis, identifying and explaining significant variances in revenue and accounts receivable balances to support financial integrity and management decision\-making.
 



 • Perform and maintain the annual SSP (standalone selling price) analysis, including management of the item master and fair value records.
 



 • Collaborate cross\-functionally with GTM, Deal Desk, and AR teams to resolve issues.
 



 • Support revenue accounting system initiatives, including implementation, testing, and optimization.
 



 • Prepare audit schedules and assist with coordination of the year\-end audit with external auditors. • Maintain the highest documentation standards.
 



 • Partner with FP\&A to provide inputs for revenue forecasts as needed.
 



 • Prepare detailed revenue packages for management and the audit committee/Board as requested.
 



 • Participate in special projects as they arise.
 



  





 What You Need
 



 • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
 



 • Strong understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
 



 • 7\+ years of experience in revenue accounting, and full\-cycle accounts receivable, ideally for SaaS companies.
 



 • Knowledge of US GAAP revenue accounting, specifically revenue from customer contracts (ASC 606\), is required.
 



 • Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and manage effectively through ambiguity and complexity.
 



 • Consistently meets deadlines, prioritizes appropriately, and remains flexible.
 



 • Advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Workspace applications.
 



 • Highly motivated, energetic self\-starter and strategic thinker.
 



 • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to build relationships within and outside the Finance team.
 



 • Experience with NetSuite ERP, NetSuite ARM, and Salesforce is required.
 



  





 Things That Make a Difference
 



 ● Familiarity with US sales tax regulations and requirements.
 



 ● Proven expertise managing full\-cycle accounts receivable processes.
 



 ● Knowledge of Order Processing.
 



 ● Hands\-on experience navigating customer procurement portals, including Coupa and Ariba.

 • Maintain the general ledger, ensure completeness of books, and oversee the Record\-to\-Report (R2R) cycle
   

 • Prepare and review financial statements in accordance with Indian GAAP / Ind AS, including P\&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements
   

 • Support preparation of consolidated financials for the group, including intercompany reconciliations and eliminations
   

 • Drive revenue assurance — monitor billing, contracts, and data flows to prevent revenue leakage in the high\-volume digital business environment
   

 • Identify and implement process improvements and automation initiatives to enhance reporting efficiency and accuracy
   


  





**Statutory Compliances** 
  




 • Ensure timely compliance with all statutory obligations
   

 • Coordinate and manage statutory audits and internal audits — liaise with auditors, review schedules, and ensure clean audit closure
   

 • Ensure compliance with FEMA regulations for cross\-border receipts, remittances, and overseas entity transactions (Singapore and UK)
   

 • Maintain and update statutory registers, fixed asset registers, and all compliance trackers
   

 • Assist in preparation of disclosures and documentation required under pre\-IPO and post\-listing regulatory requirements
   


  





**Direct Taxation** 
  




 • Manage end\-to\-end TDS compliance — deduction, challan payment, quarterly return filing (26Q, 27Q), and issuance of Form 16 / 16A
   

 • Coordinate advance tax computation and timely payment to avoid interest under Sections 234B and 234C
   

 • Support preparation and filing of corporate income tax returns, tax audit reports (Form 3CD), and transfer pricing documentation
   

 • Assist in responding to notices, assessments, and proceedings before income tax authorities
   

 • Working knowledge of withholding tax implications on international payments and DTAA provisions
   

  


**Indirect Taxation (GST)** 
  




 • Oversee GST compliance — monthly and quarterly return filing including GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, and annual return (GSTR\-9 / 9C)
   

 • Manage GSTR\-2A / 2B reconciliation and ensure maximum input tax credit utilisation
   

 • Ensure e\-invoicing compliance and e\-way bill management wherever applicable
   

 • Handle GST notices, audits, and departmental correspondence
   

 • Stay updated on GST amendments relevant to the digital / gaming / app\-based business model, including taxation of online gaming
   


  





**Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P)** 
  




 • Oversee end\-to\-end P2P cycle — purchase requisition, vendor onboarding, invoice processing, approvals, and payment disbursement
   

 • Ensure proper TDS deduction and GST treatment on vendor invoices, and timely vendor reconciliations
   

 • Manage accounts payable ageing and drive timely payment cycles without cash flow disruption
   

 • Review and strengthen vendor contracts from a financial risk and compliance standpoint
   

 • Coordinate with internal teams for accruals, prepayments, and month\-end payable reconciliations
   


  





**Order\-to\-Cash (O2C)** 
  




 • Oversee the O2C cycle including revenue recognition, invoicing, collections, and customer reconciliations
   

 • Ensure accuracy of revenue booking in line with Ind AS 115 / applicable accounting standards for digital and subscription\-based revenues
   

 • Monitor accounts receivable ageing, coordinate collections, and manage credit risk on customer accounts
   

 • Reconcile revenue from app stores (Google Play, Apple App Store) and ad monetisation platforms with internal records
   

 • Support revenue assurance processes — identify gaps between contracted, billed, and collected amounts
   


**Required Qualification**
 • Chartered Accountant (CA) with 5–7 years of post\-qualification experience in finance and accounts/ BCom with 9\-12 years of experience in a similar role.
   

 • Prior experience in a digital, gaming, SaaS, or high\-volume internet B2C company strongly preferred — candidates from companies with automated, high\-volume revenue processes (digital wallets, telco, gaming) will be given preference
   

 • Hands\-on experience across controllership, statutory compliance, GST, TDS, P2P, and O2C functions
   

 • Strong working knowledge of Indian GAAP / Ind AS and practical experience with R2R processes
   

 • Experience handling FEMA / cross\-border transactions and international entity compliance (Singapore exposure is a plus)
   

 • Proficiency in ERP systems — experience with Zoho or Tally; advanced MS Excel skills are essential
   

 • Familiarity with automation tools, financial dashboards, and process improvement initiatives
   

 • Strong attention to detail, ability to manage multiple compliance deadlines, and a proactive problem\-solving approach
   

 • Good communication skills with the ability to coordinate across functions and present to senior stakeholders
   

  

  

  

 Benefits
   

  

**What We Offer**
 • A high\-growth, pre\-IPO environment with significant career acceleration opportunity
   

 • Direct exposure to CFO and senior leadership with broad finance scope
   

 • Opportunity to build and improve finance processes from the ground up in a scaling organisation
   

 • Competitive compensation and benefits, including performance\-linked incentives
   

 • A collaborative, low\-hierarchy work culture with global exposure across India and Singapore

**Role Summary:** 




 The Assistant Registrar – Legal \& Compliance will support the Registrar and University leadership in managing legal, regulatory, statutory and governance\-related matters of the University. **Legal Affairs \& Advisory:**

* Review legal implications of proposed institutional initiatives, partnerships, contracts and administrative decisions and provide appropriate inputs.
* Coordinate responses to legal notices, claims, disputes and litigation in consultation with the Registrar and external legal counsel.
* Maintain an organised repository of legal documents, agreements, notices, case records and related correspondence.
* Maintain a comprehensive register of agreements/MoUs and monitor their validity, renewal and key contractual obligations.



**Regulatory \& Statutory Compliance:**



* Monitor compliance with the applicable University Act, Statutes, Ordinances, UGC Regulations, AICTE requirements, State higher education laws and other applicable statutory/regulatory requirements.

* Coordinate the preparation and submission of statutory returns, reports, declarations and other regulatory filings within prescribed timelines.

* Support the University during regulatory inspections, audits, accreditation processes and other statutory reviews from a legal and compliance perspective.
* Assist in identifying gaps in compliance and coordinate appropriate corrective and preventive actions.



  





**University Governance :**



* Support the functioning of statutory and governance bodies of the University, including the Board of Governors, Academic Council and other committees, as assigned.
* Assist in preparing legal notes, background documents and compliance inputs for meetings of statutory bodies.
* Support the Registrar's Office in ensuring proper documentation, follow\-up and implementation of decisions/resolutions of statutory bodies.
* Assist in reviewing University policies, rules, regulations and procedures to ensure consistency with applicable laws and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain appropriate records relating to statutory approvals, resolutions, legal opinions and governance\-related matters.

* Provide legal and compliance support in matters relating to student discipline, grievances, academic integrity and other student\-related issues.

**Risk Management \& Coordination:**

**Experience:**

* Experience in handling legal notices, disputes and coordination with external legal counsel is desirable.
* Experience in dealing with UGC, AICTE, State higher education authorities or other regulatory/statutory bodies will be an advantage.

**Skills and Competencies:**

 Partner with operations and leadership to investigate and resolve issues within project or contract transaction data. Continuously identify opportunities to streamline accounting workflows, implement better financial controls, and improve efficiency as the company scales.

 Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B.Com) required; M.Com, MBA in Finance

 Hands\-on experience with accounting tools such as

 Working understanding of Indian tax laws (GST, TDS, PF/ESI) and familiarity with US cross\-border accounting concepts.

 Advanced MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables), strong financial analysis capabilities, budgeting and forecasting, reporting and clear written/verbal English communication.

**Qualifications:**

title: Project Planner
description:
**Shape the Future of Global Industrial Projects as a Project Planner, PMO**
 Are you ready for the next step in your career? Join us as a Project Planner, PMO and play a key role in supporting complex industrial projects across the Asia Pacific region. Based in Chennai, you will work closely with project managers, site teams, subcontractors, and stakeholders to ensure projects stay on track from engineering and procurement through construction and commissioning.
   

  

 You will be at the center of project execution, transforming schedules into actionable plans, identifying risks early, and helping teams deliver successful outcomes. This is an opportunity to build expertise in global project management while contributing directly to business performance through effective planning and progress control.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* You will develop, maintain, and optimize project schedules in Safran Project or MS Project using standardized PEC templates and Valmet WBS structures.
* You will produce and manage baseline schedules, resource plans, manpower histograms, S\-curves, Earned Value reporting, and progress forecasts to provide clear project visibility.
* You will facilitate planning workshops and collaborate with project teams, discipline leads, site teams, subcontractors, and project managers to gather schedule inputs and align project objectives.
* You will monitor project progress, analyze critical paths, detect delays early, and prepare recovery or mitigation plans to keep projects on track.
* You will support project reviews, change management, claim management, risk and opportunity processes, and sales\-phase scheduling activities while communicating schedule status to internal and customer stakeholders.


**Expectations for you**
* You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in project planning, scheduling, or project controls within industrial EPC or capital investment projects. Experience across both Engineering \& Procurement and Construction \& Commissioning phases is an advantage.
* You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or another relevant technical field.
* You have hands\-on experience with professional CPM scheduling tools. Experience with Safran Project is a strong advantage, and strong Excel skills are required. Knowledge of Power BI is beneficial.
* You have customer\-facing experience and strong communication skills for leading workshops, project reviews, and stakeholder discussions.
* You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* Some travel is included in this role, although travel requirements are expected to be limited.


**To succeed in this role**
 Success in this role requires strong expertise in project scheduling, progress monitoring, and schedule analysis within complex industrial projects. You combine a solid understanding of the full project lifecycle with the ability to work accurately at a detailed activity level. You are able to manage multiple priorities independently, communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and proactively identify risks and opportunities that support successful project delivery.
   

  

 We Also Expect You To Align With Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical Behaviors That Guide How We Lead, Collaborate, And Succeed Together
   

  

* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
* Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value


**We offer**
 You will join a team of experienced planners located across Tampere, Gothenburg, Sundsvall, Copenhagen, Ulvila, and Chennai, supporting PEC projects globally. The team works closely with project organizations to develop robust schedules, monitor project performance, and improve planning practices across the business. You will gain valuable exposure to international projects and collaborate with experienced professionals across multiple regions and disciplines. Your work will have a direct impact on project success by ensuring schedules are accurate, progress is transparent, and corrective actions are taken when needed. This role offers excellent visibility into industrial project management and the opportunity to influence project outcomes on a global scale.
   

  

 At Valmet, you'll find an international and collaborative working environment where continuous learning and professional growth are encouraged. We provide modern tools, global project exposure, and opportunities to develop your expertise while contributing to sustainable industrial solutions.
   

  

 Want to know more? Did we catch your interest? We'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Please submit your application and CV by October 5, 2026\.**
 We may begin interviews before the application deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that applications submitted via email cannot be accepted.
   

  

**When everything works together**
 Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting\-edge technologies and services as well as mission\-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.
   

  

 At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.
   

  

 Join the team – and lead the way with us! www.valmet.com/careers

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth.  We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Markets Business Finance \& Control (BF\&C) is a division of Global Banking \& Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for the production and independent validation of Global Markets' profit and loss and balance sheet. In this regard, BF\&C will ensure, inter alia, that accounting policies are correctly and consistently applied, and that trading portfolios are appropriately valued.
   

  

 The team prepares and reports P\&L and balance sheet to the business and ensures the accuracy and integrity of the general ledger. We are responsible for daily service delivery and ensuring effective controls, transparent management information and becoming a center of excellence delivering process simplification and efficiencies. We work closely with front office, middle office, traders and valuation control teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 Global Markets Business Finance \& Control (BF\&C) seeks to provide a support service with particular focus on the relationship between trading risk positions and P\&L components. We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the P\&L production area covering the Global Credit Trading desks. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to produce and deliver the daily P\&L to front office, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation around any issues faced and daily revenue drivers. The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Middle Office, and Finance and Trade Capture teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Primary products covered will include: Bonds, CDS, ETFs, TRS and Loans
* Production and reporting of daily P\&L to Front Office \& Senior Management
* Reconcile actual P\&L with trader estimates and provide flash/actual variance analysis
* Working closely with the trading desks on position, P\&L or other issues on an ad\-hoc basis
* Front\-to\-Back analysis \& reconciliations of front office PnL and balance sheet to firm sub\-ledgers
* Assist with execution of month\-end controls ensuring management vs financial P\&L variances are within thresholds
* Analyze traders’ risk positions and understand and apply the Greeks (Delta, Vega Gamma) vs daily market moves
* Would be typical own set of books / cost center and Business Units
* Liaise with various business partners such as Technology, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Operations and Finance to resolve issues / queries
* Development \& continuous improvement of existing processes \& workflow
* Testing / UAT for systems work ranging from minor system releases to major system implementations
* Remediation of issues in an autonomous yet timely manner considering the principles of control and the need to mitigate operational risk


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA /CFA / MBA from Tier I/II institute
   

  

 Certifications If Any
   

  

* CFA / FRM certified candidates would be preferred
* Advanced education and/or enhanced technical qualifications are a plus
* Ability to use Access or VBA would enhance the candidate’s attractiveness significantly


**Experience Range\***
 5\+ years of experience in Global Markets
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Detailed Knowledge of product control and financial markets
* Prior BFC experience for \>4 years is mandatory
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite; expert knowledge of Excel, Word, PowerPoint. Knowledge of Visual Basic, Access databases and macros will be an added advantage.
* The right individual will have strong people skills and can multi\-task to manage the challenges of Finance processes yet have the awareness to escalate potential issues to their supervisor in a timely manner

 , you'll be the accounting expert those agents answer to. You'll review what they post, catch what they get wrong, define the rules they follow, and continuously improve how they handle real\-world accounting.
 



 This isn't a traditional accounting role. There's 
 **no audit, no routine data entry, and no visiting clients** 
 .
 



 Instead, you'll work at the intersection of 
 **accounting and AI** 
  — turning accounting knowledge into rules, logic, checks, and guardrails that allow AI agents to operate accurately at scale.
 



  





 What You'll Own
 



 → Review AI\-agent posted accounting entries, reconciliations, and exceptions across multiple client books
 



 → Identify and resolve accounting exceptions — from unusual invoices to mismatched payouts and reconciliation differences
 



 → Design and improve accounting logic, including CoA structures, posting rules, mappings, reconciliation logic, and GST treatment
 



 → Define what an AI agent can post independently and what it must escalate for human review
 



 → Build rules, prompts, checks, and guardrails that improve agent accuracy
 



 → Investigate recurring errors and convert every fix into a rule so the same problem doesn't repeat
 



 → Own the final accounting judgment on whether an entry, reconciliation, or treatment is correct
 



 → Work closely with engineers to translate accounting decisions into systems that agents can execute
 



 → Take ownership of a domain of the product end\-to\-end rather than processing a queue of files
 



**Zero manual data entry. We mean it.** 




  





 What We're Looking For
 



 → 
 **CA Inter / Semi\-qualified CA / Qualified CA** 
  with strong exposure to bookkeeping and GST
 



 → Strong accounting fundamentals — you understand 
 *why* 
  an entry is correct, not just how to pass it
 



 → Practical experience with bookkeeping, reconciliations, GST, and real\-world accounting scenarios
 



 → Ability to identify unexplained differences and investigate them until they make sense
 



 → Comfort with accounting tools, Excel, and technology
 



 → Curiosity about AI and an interest in understanding how accounting work can be automated
 



 → Ability to explain accounting decisions clearly and precisely enough for an engineer — or an AI agent — to follow
 



 → High ownership and attention to detail
 



**Coding isn't required.** 
  Our engineers handle the code; you bring the accounting judgment and logic.
 



  





 What Makes This Role Different
 



 A traditional accounting role asks:
 



**"Can you process these books correctly?"** 




 This role asks:
 



**"Can you teach a machine to process these books correctly — and know when it shouldn't?"** 




 You'll be working on the accounting intelligence behind an AI\-first product, helping us move from automating individual tasks to building agents that can reason through accounting workflows.
 



 If you've ever automated a repetitive accounting task in Excel and thought 
 *"there has to be a better way"* 
  — you'll probably enjoy this role.
 



  





 Who Should Apply?
 



**CA Inter / Semi\-qualified CA:** 
  You'll focus more on reviewing agent output, resolving exceptions, reconciliations, and progressively building accounting rules and automation logic.
 



**Qualified CA:** 
  You'll take greater ownership of accounting architecture, agent behaviour, posting logic, GST treatment, guardrails, accuracy evaluation, and product\-level accounting decisions.
 



 The exact scope will depend on your experience and depth.
 



  





 How to Apply
 



 📩 
 **naveena.rao@numerize.ai** 




**Subject:** 
  Accounting Engineer
 



 In your email, answer this:
 



**Tell us one accounting rule you'd trust an AI to apply without supervision, and one you never would.** 




 You can also tell us about the most tedious accounting task you've ever automated — 
 **Excel absolutely counts.** 




 Before applying, read 
 **"Who is an Accounting Engineer?"** 




 https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/who\-accounting\-engineer\-naveena\-rao\-bkbof/
 



 It explains the thinking behind this role better than any conventional JD can.
 



 If the idea excites you, you're probably our person.

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Business Finance and Control (BFC) sits within the CFO Org and is mainly responsible to ensure strong financial controls along with enabling the business. The Global Rates (GR) BFC supports the GR business, which falls under Global Markets and specifically in the Global Market FICC division. Counterparty Portfolio Management (CPM) BFC desk manages 2 individual VTDs that are engaged in trading, risk management and optimization activity across asset classes in Global Markets. VTDs include:
   

  

* XVA End\-User and XVA Flow (collectively, XVA) are responsible for pricing and hedging credit and funding risks on OTC derivatives executed with Global Markets clients (CVA and FVA)
* Risk Optimization Group (ROG) is primarily responsible for maximizing the efficiency of compressions of OTC derivatives between affiliates and CCPs


 The CPM BFC teams are responsible for assisting in Analysis \& reporting of PnL and ensuring integrity, completeness, and accuracy of PnL data. Teams work closely with CPM front office desks and support them on various other initiatives to enable the business and ensure better controls.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 Global Markets Business Finance \& Control (BF\&C) seeks to provide a support service with particular focus on the relationship between trading risk positions and P\&L components. We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the P\&L production area covering the Global Counterparty Portfolio Management desks. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to produce and deliver the daily P\&L to front office, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation around any issues faced and daily revenue drivers. The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Middle Office, and Finance and Trade Capture teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job.
   

  

 Strong Products knowledge of Fixed Income Derivatives (Rates, Credit, FX etc.), Concept of XVA (CVA, FVA, DVA, etc.), Bonds, Futures and Options and Capital Markets.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Primary products covered will include: Collateral, OTC Derivatives, Swaps, Repos \& Reverse Repos, Futures and options
* Production and reporting of daily P\&L to Front Office \& Senior Management
* Reconcile actual P\&L with trader estimates and provide flash/actual variance analysis
* Working closely with the trading desks on position, P\&L or other issues on an ad\-hoc basis
* Front\-to\-Back analysis \& reconciliations of front office P\&L and balance sheet to firm sub\-ledgers
* Assist with execution of month\-end controls ensuring management vs financial P\&L variances are within thresholds
* Analyze traders’ risk positions and understand and apply the Greeks (Delta, Vega Gamma) vs daily market moves
* Would be typical own set of books / cost center and Business Units
* Liaise with various business partners such as Technology, Market Risk, Rates Risk, Operations and Finance to resolve issues / queries
* Development \& continuous improvement of existing processes \& workflow
* Testing / UAT for systems work ranging from minor system releases to major system implementations
* Remediation of issues in an autonomous yet timely manner considering the principles of control and the need to mitigate operational risk


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA /CFA / MBA from Tier I/II institute
   

  

 Certifications If Any
   

  

* CFA / FRM certified candidates would be preferred
* Advanced education and/or enhanced technical qualifications are a plus
* Ability to use Access or VBA would enhance the candidate’s attractiveness significantly


 Certifications If Any
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 8\+ years of experience in Global Markets
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Detailed Knowledge of product control and financial markets
* Should have good understanding of financial markets, Derivatives \& structured notes\-their hedging, funding, Rates risk etc.
* Prior BFC experience for \>6 years is mandatory
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite; expert knowledge of Excel, Word, PowerPoint. Knowledge of Visual Basic, Access databases and macros will be an added advantage.
* The right individual will have strong people skills and can multi\-task to manage the challenges of Finance processes yet have the awareness to escalate potential issues to their supervisor in a timely manner
* Candidate must have a proven track record of communicating effectively with personnel from various areas within an organization and at different management levels
* Must be proactive and be a highly motivated and self\-starter. Reactive and/or passive individuals need not apply


**Desired Skills**
* Basic understanding and experience of using AI tools / Co\-pilot
* Alteryx / Python / Tableau knowledge would be an added advantage
* Must be proactive and be a highly\-motivated self\-starter
* Effective communication skills with English proficiency
* Demonstrated ability to work in a high pressure environment
* Takes initiative and challenges existing processes and procedures in a proactive manner
* Strong team player
* Ability to analyze issues independently and derive solutions
* Analytical skills
* Inherent sense of principles of control through experience and sound judgment
* Reliability


**Work Timings\***
 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM or 1:30 PM \-10:30 PM
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Mumbai/Hyderabad

title: Credit Analyst – Fixed Income Investments
description:
Dezerv is a house of investing solutions for high\-net\-worth and affluent Indians. Dezerv is co\-founded by Sandeep Jethwani, Vaibhav Porwal, and Sahil Contractor. They have led successful wealth management businesses and managed over USD 7 billion in assets. The Dezerv team brings together decades of investing expertise from leading global financial institutions like JP Morgan, UBS, BNP Paribas, etc. Our team of experts monitors the performance of portfolios and rebalance them if required to ensure long\-term success. We are backed by marquee firms like Premji Invest, Accel, Elevation, Matrix, etc. Since inception, our clients have trusted us with over 17000\+ Crs of their assets.
 



  





**Why are we building Dezerv?** 




 Investing is stressful and emotional. Building \& growing wealth is difficult and time\-consuming. Most individuals struggle with managing their investments and money. Our goal is to help individuals grow their wealth without the stress, time, and costs involved in a traditional investment. At Dezerv, we are building a platform that leverages our decades of investment expertise to help individuals invest better for their future.
 



  





**What are we trying to solve/mission?** 




 We are passionate about helping Indians invest better. We manage investments with active oversight to help both sophisticated and new investors build long\-term wealth across various market conditions.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We are hiring a Credit Analyst to independently assess corporate and NBFC credit opportunities across fixed\-income strategies. The role covers the full credit lifecycle: sourcing/identification, underwriting, structuring, investment recommendation and ongoing portfolio monitoring.
 



 The ideal candidate can form an independent credit view beyond ratings and standard templates, quantify downside risk, evaluate structural protections and judge whether the expected return adequately compensates for the risk.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 




 1\. Credit Underwriting \& Investment Decisions
 



 • Independently underwrite corporate and NBFC credits and prepare clear investment recommendations.
 



 • Analyse business fundamentals, financial statements, cash flows, leverage, liquidity and capital structure.
 



 • Assess promoter quality, governance, business risks, industry dynamics and key downside scenarios.
 



 • Evaluate probability of default, loss given default and the range of plausible downside outcomes.
 



 • Assess risk\-adjusted return and form a clear invest / do\-not\-invest view.
 



  





 2\. Debt Structures \& Documentation
 



 • Evaluate NCDs, bonds, structured credit and other fixed\-income opportunities.
 



 • Analyse security packages, guarantees, collateral, escrow / DSRA structures and covenants.
 



 • Understand how structure and documentation affect recovery, downside protection and enforceability.
 



  





 3\. Portfolio Monitoring
 



 • Monitor portfolio credits and identify early\-warning signals before deterioration becomes visible in ratings.
 



 • Track covenant compliance, liquidity, refinancing risk, rating actions and financial performance.
 



 • Recommend actions where the original investment thesis changes, including hold, reduce, exit or enhanced monitoring.
 



  





 4\. Market \& Stakeholder Interaction
 



 • Conduct issuer / management meetings and independently challenge the investment thesis.
 



 • Interact with issuers, arrangers, rating agencies, trustees, legal advisors and other market participants.
 



 • Work closely with the Fund Manager on portfolio construction, position sizing, exits and portfolio optimisation.
 



  





**Must\-Have Profile** 




 • 5\+ years of relevant experience in credit analysis, credit investing, underwriting or a closely related institutional
 



 credit role.
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience analysing corporate and/or NBFC credit.
 



 • Strong financial statement, cash\-flow, leverage and liquidity analysis skills.
 



 • Ability to build, audit and interpret financial models rather than rely only on standard templates.
 



 • Strong understanding of debt instruments, credit structures, security packages and covenants.
 



 • Ability to independently form and defend an investment view, including downside and recovery analysis.
 



 • High attention to detail, commercial judgement and intellectual curiosity.
 



  





**Preferred Background** 




 • Buy\-side credit: PMS, AIF, mutual fund or institutional investment platform.
 



 • Private credit / structured credit.
 



 • NBFC credit.
 



 • Corporate credit underwriting.
 



 • Credit research or rating agency experience with strong analytical and underwriting exposure.
 



 • CA / CFA / MBA (Finance) preferred.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 This role suits someone who naturally asks:
 



 • What can go wrong?
 



 • How much can we lose?
 



 • What protects us if the thesis goes wrong?
 



 • Are we being adequately compensated for taking this risk?
 



 Candidates whose work is primarily limited to monitoring ratings, filling standard credit templates or reviewing
 



 historical financials without forming an independent investment view are unlikely to be a fit.
 



  





**Why This Role** 




 • Direct exposure to buy\-side credit investing and portfolio management.
 



 • Close involvement with the Fund Manager on live investment decisions.
 



 • Opportunity to evaluate differentiated credit opportunities across sectors and structures.
 



 • Significant interaction with issuers and market participants.
 



 • High ownership and visibility across the investment process.
 



 • Opportunity to develop into a credit investment specialist / portfolio manager over time.

description:
**Company Description:** 





 Benne is a fast\-growing South Indian QSR chain currently operating 4 stores across Mumbai and Delhi, with an ambitious 3\-year plan to scale to 18 stores. We are backed by institutional angel investors and in advanced stages of closing a Pre\-Series A from a family office. We are building a category\-defining brand in South Indian cuisine with a strong focus on product quality, unit economics, and operational excellence.
 




  





**Role Description** 
 :
 



 •      
 
 Own the monthly close — consolidated P\&L, store\-wise performance dashboards, and working capital summary
 




 •      
 
 Prepare monthly MIS packs for the founders and Board with clear commentary on variances

 Drive quarterly and annual financial reviews with actionable insights on unit economics
 




 •      
 
 Manage the audit process (statutory, internal) and ensure timely completion
 




 •      
 
 Prepare and submit investor reporting as per SHA obligations
 




 •      
 
 Support the founders in due diligence processes, data room management, and financial Q\&A during fundraises
 




 •      
 
 Ensure all ROC, GST, TDS, PF, PT, FSSAI\-related filings are current and compliant
 




 •      
 
 Maintain the cap table and be the internal point of contact for CCPS\-related calculations and filings
 




 •      
 
 Manage day\-to\-day cash flow across all stores, handle vendor payment cycles, and ensure sufficient runway at all times
 




 •      
 
 Own banking relationships — manage working capital facilities, term loans, and negotiate terms with lenders
 




 •      
 
 Build and maintain a 13\-week rolling cash flow forecast
 




 •      
 
 Evaluate and structure debt instruments as needed to support store expansion
 




 •      
 
 Lead the annual budgeting process across all stores and functions
 




 •      
 
 Own the 3\-year financial model — update quarterly actuals, refresh projections, and stress\-test assumptions
 




 •      
 
 Benchmark store\-level performance against budget: food cost, labour cost, occupancy, and EBITDA
 




 •      
 
 Identify cost optimisation opportunities and work with operations to implement them
 




 •      
 
 Manage and mentor the existing finance team (Senior Accountant \+ Junior Accountant)
 




 •      
 
 Build a hiring plan for the function aligned to the store expansion roadmap
 




 •      
 
 Own the accounting systems (Tally or equivalent) and identify ERP/tech upgrades as the business scales
 




 •      
 
 Establish SOPs for accounts payable, vendor reconciliation, and inventory accounting in a QSR context
 




  





**Must Have:** 




 •      
 
 Chartered Accountant (CA) with 8–12 years of post\-qualification experience
 




 •      
 
 Hands\-on experience in F\&B, QSR, retail, or consumer brands at a scaling company
 




 •      
 
 Strong understanding of unit economics in a multi\-location business (food cost %, labour cost %, EBITDA per store)
 




 •      
 
 Experience managing statutory compliance, audits, and regulatory filings independently
 




  
 
 •  
 

 Ability to operate at both strategic and execution levels — you should be comfortable building an MIS pack and presenting it to a Board in the same week
 




 •      
 
 Prior experience in a PE/VC\-backed company with institutional investor reporting obligations
 




 •      
 
 Exposure to CCPS structures, SHA compliance, and cap table management
 




 •      
 
 Experience with debt structuring — working capital facilities, term loans, NBFC relationships
 




 •      
 
 Familiarity with Zoho Books, Tally Prime, or ERP migration projects
 




 •      
 
 Prior experience building a finance team from scratch
 




  





**Why join US:** 




 •      
 
 Meaningful ownership of the finance function at a brand that is scaling fast — you will build the infrastructure, not inherit it
 




 •      
 
 Direct exposure to founders, Board, and institutional investors from day one
 




 •      
 
 Front\-row seat to a Pre\-Series A close and the decisions that follow it
 




 •      
 
 Opportunity to grow into a CFO\-track role as the company scales to 18\+ stores

title: Strategy & Operations Associate
description:
**About the Role** 




 Limese is a Korean beauty distribution company operating across India, the UAE, and Europe, and we're launching our own brands alongside distribution. We're looking for someone who can take a messy, half\-defined problem, figure out what needs to happen, and drive it to done across teams.
 



  





 This is a high\-exposure role. You'll work closely with leadership on the company's top priorities, but you'll also be embedded in the team and accountable like everyone else. There's no fixed lane. You'll start across many projects, and over time the areas where you're strongest become yours to own.
 



  





**What you'll actually be doing** 



* Running cross\-functional projects end to end, such as a new brand launch, a new market entry, a marketplace rollout, or a process that's broken
* Turning leadership priorities into clear plans, owners, and timelines, then following up until they ship
* Tracking business performance across channels and markets and pulling together the numbers that drive decisions
* Preparing analysis, briefs, and decks for partner, brand, and internal reviews
* Spotting gaps between brand, ops, warehouse, and finance, and fixing them
* Getting hands\-on when something needs doing, whether that's vendor calls, partner onboarding, or sorting out a stuck shipment



  





**Who this is for** 



* You're structured in your thinking but comfortable with ambiguity
* You're strong with Excel and numbers, and you write clearly
* You can influence without authority. You get things done by earning trust with teams, not by title
* You act without waiting for instructions and close loops without being chased
* You want to eventually own a business vertical, not stay a coordinator
* 2–5 years of experience in consulting, a startup, e\-commerce, or a founder's office type role is a plus but not required



  





**One honest note** 




 This role sits close to leadership, but it isn't a layer above the team. You'll report into our leadership structure like everyone else and be measured on what you deliver. Much of the work is unglamorous execution. If you're looking for a strategy\-only role or a title, this isn't it. If you want to learn how a multi\-country business actually runs and earn your way to owning part of it, you'll fit in well here.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Email careers@limesecos.com with your realistic salary expectations, why you're leaving your last role, and one project you drove end to end: what was broken, what you did, and what changed.

title: Head of Equity Research
description:
**Company Description** 
 WealthCulture is a SEBI\-registered Investment Advisor and Research Analyst dedicated to empowering retail investors through long\-term, research\-driven investing. Founded in 2022 and based in Mumbai, the firm focuses on building a culture of wealth creation by sharing practical insights on investing, financial markets, business models, and valuation. We manage 100\+ Cr of Assets Under Advisory across 500\+ clients.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Head of Equity Research role based in Mumbai. The Head of Equity Research will lead the equity research function, overseeing the end\-to\-end research process, including idea generation, fundamental analysis, valuation, and investment recommendations on listed equities. The role involves managing and mentoring a research team, setting research standards and frameworks, and ensuring that coverage is rigorous, timely, and aligned with the firm’s investment philosophy. The individual will review and approve research reports, thematic notes, and sector deep dives, and will present key findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, to clients or public\-facing educational platforms. The Head of Equity Research will collaborate closely with advisory and compliance teams to maintain consistency, transparency, and regulatory adherence across all research outputs.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong analytical skills with proven ability to interpret financial statements, build valuation models, and synthesize complex data into clear investment insights.
* Deep expertise in equities, including sector coverage, company analysis, and monitoring of listed companies in Indian and global markets.
* Hands\-on experience in investments and portfolio construction, with an understanding of risk management and long\-term, research\-driven investing.
* Advanced proficiency in equity research, including initiating coverage, writing detailed research reports, and maintaining ongoing coverage under SEBI\-compliant standards.
* Solid finance foundation, preferably supported by qualifications such as CA, CFA, MBA in Finance, or equivalent professional experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial concepts to both sophisticated and retail audiences.
* Experience leading and developing research teams, setting research processes, and maintaining high\-quality standards in a regulated environment.
* Comfort with data tools and platforms (e.g., Excel, financial databases, modeling software) and openness to integrating technology and automation into research workflows.
* High ethical standards, attention to detail, and commitment to regulatory compliance and investor protection.

title: Assistant Manager - WM SCS Equity Option Derivatives
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Controller (Assistant Manager)
   

  

**Department:** 
 Wealth Management – Operations (Equity Option Derivatives)
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 The Wealth Management (WM) – Derivatives Operations team is responsible for the end\-to\-end lifecycle management of Equity Derivatives. This includes processing complex trade types such as OTC Equity, Bonds, Index, Listed, and Exotic Options, as well as Swaps. The function is critical in ensuring trade accuracy, regulatory compliance, and seamless settlement processes to support the bank’s trading activities and client requirements.
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 The Controller is responsible for the accurate processing and lifecycle management of derivative instruments. The role focuses on maintaining the integrity of bank and client positions, ensuring strict adherence to the operational permanent control framework, and managing the reconciliation of cash and securities. The Controller acts as a key liaison between dealers, counterparties, and the Front Office to resolve discrepancies and mitigate operational risk.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Direct Responsibilities**
* Execute the accurate and timely processing of OTC Equity, Bond, Index, Listed, and Exotic Options and Swap trades, ensuring continuity during public holidays.
* Maintain and update trade data in the Olympic system to ensure both bank and client positions are accurately reflected.
* Verify and authorize cash settlement instructions to Nostro banks, ensuring timely settlement and managing all related cash outflows.
* Liaise actively with dealers, counterparties, and the Front Office to identify and resolve trade discrepancies promptly.
* Review, sign, and manage transaction supplements, counterparty confirmations, and manual client advice; proactively monitor and follow up on non\-receipt of confirmations.
* Investigate and resolve Nostro and securities reconciliation breaks, including the pursuit of necessary interest claims.
* Strictly adhere to internal procedures, control measures, and regulatory requirements. Monitor and report error trades to management and ensure the formal receipt of incident reports.
* Ensure all spread charges remain within the monetary limits stipulated in the “Disclosure of Sales Related Information” and obtain formal management approval for any special waivers.
* Review daily control reports, monitor late or failed trades, and provide regular updates to Management to mitigate operational impact.
* Serve as a point of contact for queries from the Front Office, Advisory Desks, and counterparties to ensure smooth functional operations.
* Systematically update and maintain the database worksheets for all option trades.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Contribute to the implementation of operational permanent control policies and procedures in day\-to\-day business activities.
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system enhancements and support ad hoc projects as required by management.
* Identify and contribute to workflow improvements to enhance operational efficiency and mitigate risk.


**Specific Qualifications**
* Minimum 7–8 years of experience in Derivatives Operations or a similar control\-oriented role.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Management, or a related field.
* Prior experience in Equity Derivatives or OTC markets is highly preferred.


**Technical Skills**

title: Principal Engineer - Technical Due Diligence
description:
**Job Description**
 WSP is seeking an engineering professional to deliver technical due diligence services for large\-scale Power and Water infrastructure projects across the Middle East region. This multifaceted role combines deep technical expertise with a strong understanding of techno\-economic and techno\-legal aspects of Project Finance, particularly within Public\-Private Partnership (PPP) frameworks.
   

  

 The successful candidate will support lenders and investors, including multilateral development banks, export credit agencies, and private equity firms, by providing independent technical assessments, monitoring project execution, and ensuring compliance with contractual, regulatory, and performance standards throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 This role offers exposure to high\-value utility infrastructure projects and provides a unique opportunity to contribute to both technical and financial dimensions of infrastructure development.
   

  

**Location:**
 Bengaluru / Noida / Mumbai
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Contribute to technical due diligence for project feasibility assessments, with a strong grasp of PPP procurement models.
* Identify and evaluate construction, technology, and regulatory risks.
* Review and validate project schedules, cost estimates, and risk allocation mechanisms.
* Analyze and assess key project documents including Offtaker Specifications, Project Agreements like Offtaker Contracts, EPC Contracts, O\&M Agreements, and other technical contracts for compliance with international standards and regional precedents.
* Contribute in Preparation of comprehensive technical due diligence reports, construction monitoring reports, and operational performance reviews for lenders and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to gather inputs and ensure quality and consistency in reporting.
* Review technical assumptions embedded in financial models for utility\-scale power and water projects.
* Conduct buyer and seller due diligence as a technical advisor to stakeholders.
* Perform Capex and Opex benchmarking for utility scale power and water assets.
* Ensure adherence to health \& safety standards, quality management systems (QMS), and project lifecycle protocols.
* Participate in project meetings, contribute to business development efforts, and provide feedback on new opportunities.

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical) or related field.

description:

**Job Description**
 PRIMARY FUNCTIONS AND ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES
   

  

* Day\-to\-day hands\-on responsibilities for fund operations, fund reporting and investor reporting.
* Daily detailed review of cash activity and corresponding system bookings. Update cash projections, including expected settlement timing of investment activity (i.e.: interest payments, fundings and realizations), payment of expenses, and timing of LP capital calls and capital distributions.
* Daily monitoring of capital call and distribution requirements, preparation of detailed capital activity descriptions, detailed review of allocations from the Fund administrator and compilation of final capital activity package.
* Processing and detailed review of ongoing operating expenses, including invoice set\-up, GL coding and payment wires. Prepare quarterly expense budget including payments for the quarter and accruals for unpaid expenses.

* Process improvement, identify manual steps, recurring errors, and reconciliation issues; propose automation or standardization opportunities
* Assist with review of monthly cash and investment transactions and holdings, including flux analysis and research and resolving any breaks.
* Assist with preparation and detailed review of quarterly and annual GAAP financial statements and footnote disclosures for multiple funds.
* Assist with preparation of quarterly NAV/AUM estimates and completing required templates on an accelerated timeline, used by the Management company in firmwide quarterly results.
* Hands\-on production, detail\-orientation and critical thinking, as well as productive and effective coordination with external fund administrators, other F\&A/internal teams.
* Adapt to an environment of teamwork, collaboration, integrity, self\-awareness, diligence, ownership and accountability.


 EDUCATION
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree required in related field (Finance, Accounting or Economics) from accredited institution.
* Chartered Accountant or CPA license preferred


**Experience Required**
* Minimum 3\-5 years of experience in credit, fund\-of\-fund or private equity fund accounting preferred.
* Big 4 audit firms/ Asset Manager Industry experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP
* Familiarity with systems such as Geneva and Power BI highly desirable.
* Strong proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and Word (e.g.: complex formulas, macros)
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau or other business intelligence tools, a plus


**General Requirements**
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, high growth environment.
* Highly motivated team player with a strong work ethic.
* Flexibility in switching priorities or assisting the team when called to over personal tasks
* Highest degree of integrity, motivation and intellectual curiosity
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills \- Ability to analyze and summarize complex information both verbally and in writing with colleagues in the United States
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills \- research and leverage available resources to accomplish the task at hand
* Ability to multi\-task, prioritize/manage deadlines.
* Intermediate or advanced Excel user.
* Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills; attention to detail and timelines required
* Knowledge of private equity structures, fixed income securities, debt instruments, alternative investments, securitization, or other investment products preferred
* Proven experience of collaborating with teams in remote locations to ensure efficiency, effectiveness and high level of supervisory oversight
* Comfort in dealing with ambiguity and uncertainty in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment
* Energetic, self\-motivated, and team\-oriented approach; a zest for challenges in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment – often under pressure to meet demanding deadlines
* Strong work ethic, an entrepreneurial spirit and a desire to learn
* Dependable, great attitude, highly motivated and a team player

 Principal, Strategic Partnerships
