We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Workday Success Plans team works directly with customers through targeted micro\-consulting engagements to help them get the most out of their Workday investment. Our mission is to serve as trusted Workday advisors, guiding customers through how\-to questions, configuration challenges, feature demonstrations, and best\-practice guidance — all with the goal of helping them translate their business needs into real results using the Workday platform.
   

  

 Our team of professionals brings a broad and deep understanding of Workday, and we take genuine pride in helping customers solve problems, discover new features, and unlock greater value across their Workday environment. In the year ahead, this team will continue to expand its focus on Financial Reporting, Workday Prism Analytics, and Workday Accounting Center — helping customers turn complex accounting requirements and external data sources into actionable insights and unified dashboards.
   

  

 What makes this team special is the variety and pace of the work. No two engagements are quite the same, and you will constantly be learning — whether it is a new product feature, a creative customer use case, or an emerging industry practice. If you are passionate about the value technology can bring to an organization, love learning, and want to work directly with some of the greatest companies on the planet, the Workday Success Plans team is the place for you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Workday Success Plans Consultant specializing in Financial Reporting
   

  

 you will serve as a subject matter expert, helping customers translate complex financial requirements into well\-designed Workday solutions. You will act as a trusted advisor across a diverse set of micro\-consulting engagements, ensuring customers get the guidance they need to optimize their use of Workday Financial Reporting, Prism Analytics, and Accounting Center.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Designing, building, and troubleshooting complex Workday Financial reports, including Composite, Matrix, and Advanced reports (e.g., P\&L, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, and Cash Flow)
* Guiding customers on how to ingest, prepare, and blend high volumes of external operational data with core Workday financial data using Workday Prism Analytics
* Advising on the configuration of Workday Accounting Center to transform external business events into detailed accounting journal entries and subledgers
* Designing and troubleshooting Prism data pipelines, datasets, and calculated fields to support advanced variance analysis, trended P\&L reporting, and unified dashboards
* Advising customers on financial reporting best practices, including the impact of Chart of Accounts design, custom organizations, and worktags on reporting outcomes
* Delivering customer presentations on how to use Workday features to achieve business goals, including Accelerator Webinars and Feature Accelerator sessions focused on financial dashboards, Prism integrations, and Accounting Center rules
* Reviewing customer tenants to identify adoption opportunities through Feature Adoption Tenant Reviews
* Performing configuration and business requirements reviews with detailed deliverables highlighting opportunities for optimization
* Providing one\-on\-one customer configuration designs and supporting full feature deployments
* Maintaining product expertise and Workday Certification(s) while staying current with the Workday roadmap and industry practices
* Helping drive the creation of new programs to accelerate customer feature adoption


 This role may require up to 20% travel.
   

  

**About You**
 Basic Qualifications
   

  

* 8\+ years of IT implementation experience
* 8\+ years of experience with HR and/or Finance systems, including but not limited to Workday, PeopleSoft, SAP, Oracle, and/or JD Edwards
* 2\+ years of software consulting experience
* Experience gathering financial requirements and building complex financial reports for finance teams (Controllers, FP\&A, and similar audiences)
* Hands\-on experience with data integration, data modeling, or building data pipelines (ETL processes) to support financial analytics


**Other Qualifications**
* Experienced in building and maintaining trusted customer relationships, with the ability to understand client needs, provide thoughtful guidance, and ensure a positive experience across every engagement
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to adapt your style to different audiences — from technical teams to finance leaders — and clearly articulate complex Workday concepts in an approachable way
* Ability to understand and connect concepts across multiple Workday functional areas, including Financial Reporting, Prism Analytics, and Accounting Center, to deliver holistic guidance to customers
* Workday Certification in at least one of the following is ideal: Reporting, Composite Reporting, Record to Report, Prism Analytics, or Accounting Center. Familiarity with Workday Prism architecture, including table structures, data transformations, and security alignment across internal and external data sets
* Skilled in delivering clear, engaging presentations and product demonstrations to customer audiences, with the ability to present complex information in a compelling manner that helps customers understand and adopt Workday features
* Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and departments, bringing diverse perspectives together to deliver the best outcomes for customers
* Understanding of software implementation methodologies and best practices, with the ability to guide customers through configuration design and feature deployment in a structured and repeatable way
* Ability to manage multiple engagements and deliverables simultaneously, prioritizing effectively to deliver high\-quality results on time
* Willingness to share knowledge and expertise with team members, helping to develop the broader team's capabilities and contributing to a culture of continuous learning
* Ability to take ownership of engagements and guide customers and internal teams toward successful outcomes, demonstrating initiative and accountability
* Skilled in leading discussions, workshops, and discovery sessions with customers to identify needs, align on solutions, and drive productive outcomes
* Ability to understand complex, technical process issues and facilitate collaborative problem\-solving across customer and internal teams to arrive at the best solution
* Ability to navigate differing viewpoints and address customer concerns in a professional manner, finding constructive paths forward that maintain trust and collaboration
* Understanding of accounting principles and financial processes (General Ledger, Procurement, Expenses, Business Assets) to ensure reports and configurations are accurate
* Ability to gain a thorough understanding of Workday concepts as new features are released
* Proficiency in English, both verbal and written
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or relevant work experience. Advanced degree preferred


**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

 Our team of professionals brings a broad and deep understanding of Workday, and we take genuine pride in helping customers solve problems, discover new features, and unlock greater value across their Workday environment. In the year ahead, this team will continue to expand its focus on HCM/Financial Reporting, Workday Prism Analytics, and Workday Accounting Center — helping customers turn complex accounting requirements and external data sources into actionable insights and unified dashboards.
   

  

 What makes this team special is the variety and pace of the work. No two engagements are quite the same, and you will constantly be learning — whether it is a new product feature, a creative customer use case, or an emerging industry practice. If you are passionate about the value technology can bring to an organization, love learning, and want to work directly with some of the greatest companies on the planet, the Workday Success Plans team is the place for you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Workday Success Plans Consultant specializing in HCM/Financial Reporting and
 **Prism Analytics** 
 , you will serve as a subject matter expert, helping customers translate complex financial requirements into well\-designed Workday solutions. You will act as a trusted advisor across a diverse set of micro\-consulting engagements, ensuring customers get the guidance they need to optimize their use of Workday Financial Reporting, Prism Analytics, and Accounting Center.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Designing, building, and troubleshooting complex Workday Financial reports, including Composite, Matrix, and Advanced reports (e.g., P\&L, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, and Cash Flow)
* Guiding customers on how to ingest, prepare, and blend high volumes of external operational data with core Workday financial data using Workday Prism Analytics
* Advising on the configuration of Workday Accounting Center to transform external business events into detailed accounting journal entries and subledgers
* Designing and troubleshooting Prism data pipelines, datasets, and calculated fields to support advanced variance analysis, trended P\&L reporting, and unified dashboards
* Advising customers on financial reporting best practices, including the impact of Chart of Accounts design, custom organizations, and worktags on reporting outcomes
* Delivering customer presentations on how to use Workday features to achieve business goals, including Accelerator Webinars and Feature Accelerator sessions focused on financial dashboards, Prism integrations, and Accounting Center rules
* Reviewing customer tenants to identify adoption opportunities through Feature Adoption Tenant Reviews
* Performing configuration and business requirements reviews with detailed deliverables highlighting opportunities for optimization
* Providing one\-on\-one customer configuration designs and supporting full feature deployments
* Maintaining product expertise and Workday Certification(s) while staying current with the Workday roadmap and industry practices
* Helping drive the creation of new programs to accelerate customer feature adoption

 Basic Qualifications
   

  

* 8\+ years of IT implementation experience
* 8\+ years of experience with HR and/or Finance systems, including but not limited to Workday, PeopleSoft, SAP, Oracle, and/or JD Edwards
* 2\+ years of software consulting experience
* Experience gathering financial requirements and building complex financial reports for finance teams (Controllers, FP\&A, and similar audiences)
* Hands\-on experience with data integration, data modeling, or building data pipelines (ETL processes) to support financial analytics


**Other Qualifications**
* Experienced in building and maintaining trusted customer relationships, with the ability to understand client needs, provide thoughtful guidance, and ensure a positive experience across every engagement
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to adapt your style to different audiences — from technical teams to finance leaders — and clearly articulate complex Workday concepts in an approachable way
* Ability to understand and connect concepts across multiple Workday functional areas, including Financial Reporting, Prism Analytics, and Accounting Center, to deliver holistic guidance to customers
* Workday Certification in at least one of the following is ideal: Reporting, Composite Reporting, Record to Report, Prism Analytics, or Accounting Center. Familiarity with Workday Prism architecture, including table structures, data transformations, and security alignment across internal and external data sets
* Skilled in delivering clear, engaging presentations and product demonstrations to customer audiences, with the ability to present complex information in a compelling manner that helps customers understand and adopt Workday features
* Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and departments, bringing diverse perspectives together to deliver the best outcomes for customers
* Understanding of software implementation methodologies and best practices, with the ability to guide customers through configuration design and feature deployment in a structured and repeatable way
* Ability to manage multiple engagements and deliverables simultaneously, prioritizing effectively to deliver high\-quality results on time
* Willingness to share knowledge and expertise with team members, helping to develop the broader team's capabilities and contributing to a culture of continuous learning
* Ability to take ownership of engagements and guide customers and internal teams toward successful outcomes, demonstrating initiative and accountability
* Skilled in leading discussions, workshops, and discovery sessions with customers to identify needs, align on solutions, and drive productive outcomes
* Ability to understand complex, technical process issues and facilitate collaborative problem\-solving across customer and internal teams to arrive at the best solution
* Ability to navigate differing viewpoints and address customer concerns in a professional manner, finding constructive paths forward that maintain trust and collaboration
* Understanding of accounting principles and financial processes (General Ledger, Procurement, Expenses, Business Assets) to ensure reports and configurations are accurate
* Ability to gain a thorough understanding of Workday concepts as new features are released
* Proficiency in English, both verbal and written
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or relevant work experience. Advanced degree preferred

 **Role Summary** 




 A highly specialized role responsible for safeguarding the organization’s contractual, financial and legal interests during project execution. This leader will drive the contract administration strategy, masterfully handle day to day contract administration, Extension of Time (EoT) and prolongation claims, and lead dispute resolution and arbitration proceedings to minimize legal and financial exposure.

 We’re the only Real Estate company to be recognised in the top 10 mid\-size organisations six times in a row by the Great Places to Work® Institute, and we continue to feature amongst the Top 50 Great Mid\-Size WorkplacesTM 2024 in India. In 2024, we have also been proudly recognised as one of India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Real Estate, and India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Building a Culture of Innovation for All. As we raise the bar on service orientation, product innovation, real estate marketing, and brand building, we are consciously creating a workplace where our employees achieve new heights in their areas of expertise.
 



  





**Our people\-forward culture** 




 How did we achieve this? By cheering for our outdoers. We care about our people, and invest in their success. We cultivate a culture of innovation, inclusiveness, high growth and rewards, inspiring our employees to challenge themselves, and besting their own past performance to achieve their professional goals and their self\-development objectives.
 



  





**ROLE PURPOSE** 




 To support the land acquisition team in screening, analysing, and tracking real estate transactions from lead stage to decision stage, with strong focus on development potential, underwriting accuracy, regulatory diligence, and management\-note preparation.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 • Evaluate land, redevelopment, JV/JDA, DM, and plotted development opportunities from first cut to management recommendation.
 



 • Prepare detailed area and yield workings covering plot area, deductions, FSI/TDR/premium FSI, ancillary areas, parking, amenities, carpet, built\-up, and saleable area assumptions.

Phase 1 of Evora Service Partner will serve our Germany and USA entities, with a clear expansion roadmap to additional regions.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**Who We Are Looking For**
 The Finance Lead – Evora Service Partner is a senior individual contributor and team lead role based in India, forming part of Evora Group's shared finance delivery model. The role sits within the Evora Service Partner (ESP) organisation in India and operates as a dedicated finance function supporting Evora Group's global entities.
   

  

 You will lead a team of finance professionals in India who provide shared finance services — including general ledger accounting, financial reporting, and process operations — to Evora Group entities globally. While your day\-to\-day employment and people management are with the ESP Head in India, your finance work is directed by and closely aligned with the Global Finance Lead, ensuring full integration with Evora Group's global finance function.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact role for a finance professional who combines technical depth in accounting with a service\-delivery mindset, the ability to build trusted cross\-cultural working relationships, and the drive to lead a team delivering excellence from India to the world.

The GM will work closely with the owners/management to execute innovative ideas that enhance revenue, profitability, and brand positioning of the resort. Key Responsibilities: 1\. Overall Resort Administration. Lead and manage all departments: Front Office, Housekeeping, F\&B, Kitchen, Spa/Activities, Security, Engineering, Finance, HR and Stores.
 


* Develop and implement SOPs for all operational areas to ensure consistency, efficiency and high service standards.

* Resolve operational bottlenecks quickly and maintain high standards of cleanliness, safety, and guest service.
* Conduct daily/weekly departmental review meetings and ensure coordination between teams.
* Monitor procurement, inventory and cost control for food, beverages, linens, amenities and other supplies.



  





 3\. Legal, Licensing and Statutory ComplianceEnsure all licenses and registrations (hospitality, FSSAI, liquor, local tourism, pollution control, fire safety, music/entertainment, etc.) are valid, renewed on time and properly documented.

* Track revenue streams (rooms, F\&B, banquets, events, activities, spa, ancillary services) and drive strategies to increase yield and profitability.

* 7\. Guest Experience and Service QualityEnsure a guest\-centric culture in the resort, with consistent, warm and professional service.

* Design and implement staff schedules, performance reviews, rewards and disciplinary actions as needed.

**Company Overview**

**Organizational Overview**
 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors.  This role will be responsible for Collections Strategy analytics to generate insights in strategy development, implementation, and performance monitoring of complex, regulatory\-sensitive loss mitigation programs. The person in this role will participate in the design of challenger (test) strategies including eligibility criteria, opportunity sizing, performance monitoring, and on\-going strategy enhancement. This includes obtaining Working Group and Tollgate approvals, strategy sheet updates, requests to Strategy Delivery, and tracking pre \& post implementation validations (if applicable).

* 4\+ years’ experience in SAS, SQL, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, organizational and written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to make decisions and recommendations based on quantitative analysis and creative thinking
* Strong self\-starter balanced with desire to achieve team goals
* Ability to handle sensitive issues with uncompromising integrity and confidentiality

title: Commercial & Transformation Lead
description:
**Mission Brief** 




  





 Transform how Lenskart buys, negotiates and creates value from every rupee it spends.
 



 Lenskart is scaling rapidly across manufacturing, retail, supply chain and multiple geographies. At this scale, commercial decisions are no longer just about procurement. They are a strategic lever for growth, margin and competitive advantage.
 



 The opportunity is to bring greater intelligence, discipline and technology into how we manage external spend, from manufacturing inputs and logistics to retail, technology and corporate categories.
 



 Your mandate is to close the gap between what we spend and what we should spend and create a commercial engine that is data\-led, AI\-enabled and deeply connected to the business.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complex, ambiguous business problems and turning those solutions into measurable outcomes.
 



  





**What You Will Own:** 




  





 Commercial Intelligence \& AI
 



 Shape Lenskart’s commercial intelligence layer across:
 


* Spend analytics, should\-cost models and total\-cost\-of\-ownership frameworks
* Supplier intelligence, scorecards and risk assessment
* E\-sourcing and contract intelligence
* AI\-assisted negotiation and price discovery
* Automated, data\-led decision making across categories



  





 The goal is to move from fragmented information and manual decision\-making to a system where
 **the data tells us where the opportunity is and technology helps us act on it.** 




  





 Strategic Sourcing \& P\&L Impact
 



 Own the commercial opportunity across a broad spend universe:
 



**Direct:** 
 Frames, lenses, coatings, accessories, packaging and manufacturing inputs
 



**Indirect:** 
 Store CapEx and OpEx, marketing, technology and corporate spend
 



**Supply Chain:** 
 Logistics, last\-mile, lab\-to\-store, make\-vs\-buy and network optimisation
 



 You will be expected to identify structural opportunities, develop category strategies and deliver measurable YoY P\&L impact through
 **should\-cost, TCO, value engineering and smarter commercial models.** 




  





 Negotiation \& Supplier Strategy
 



 Lead some of Lenskart’s highest\-value commercial negotiations while establishing greater negotiation rigour across the organisation.
 



  





 This includes developing stronger supplier strategies, benchmarking markets, understanding cost structures, defining negotiation playbooks and creating clear walk\-away positions.
 



 The objective is not simply to
 **negotiate harder** 
 , but to fundamentally improve the economics of the relationships we enter into.
 



  





 Business Problem Solving \& Leadership
 



 This role sits at the intersection of multiple parts of the business.
 



 You will work closely with
 **Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Retail, Technology and Marketing** 
 , as well as the founders and senior leadership team, on problems where the answer is not always obvious.
 



  





 You will be expected to:
 


* Break down complex business problems into clear commercial decisions.
* Challenge existing ways of working using data and first\-principles thinking.
* Translate business requirements into technology and AI solutions.
* Take ideas from analysis through implementation and measurable impact.
* Influence stakeholders across functions and drive adoption at scale.



  





 Who We’re Looking For
 



 We are looking for someone who
 **thinks like a business leader, not a functional specialist.** 




 You may come from strategy, consulting, business operations, supply chain, sourcing, procurement, corporate development or a high\-growth operating environment.
 



 What matters is that you have demonstrated:
 


* Strong problem\-solving ability across ambiguous, high\-impact business situations.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.
* Strong commercial and analytical instincts.
* Exposure to supply chain, sourcing, cost structures or commercial strategy.
* The ability to connect
 **strategy, economics, technology and execution.**
* A track record of taking ownership for outcomes, not just recommendations.
* Curiosity and instinct to use AI and technology to fundamentally improve how work gets done.



 Experience with
 **manufacturing, APAC, China or Middle East supply ecosystems** 
 is a strong advantage.
 



  





 Why This Role
 



**This is not a traditional procurement role.** 




 You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most consequential commercial problems at Lenskart, with visibility into the decisions that shape
 **margin, supply chain, capital allocation and growth.** 




  





 You will work closely with the
 **founders and senior leadership** 
 , operate across the full business and have significant ownership over the direction of the commercial function.
 



 The scale is substantial:
 **2,500\+ stores, hundreds of suppliers, multiple geographies and an increasingly complex manufacturing and supply chain ecosystem.** 




  





 The opportunity is to combine
 **business problem solving, commercial strategy, supply chain thinking and technology** 
 to create a capability that can materially change Lenskart’s economics.

title: Business Administration (MBA) - AI Content Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
 What if your MBA — your hard\-won expertise in corporate finance, market strategy, and business operations — could directly shape how AI advises executives and drives decisions for millions of businesses around the world?
   

  

 We're looking for MBA\-qualified professionals to work with Alignerr, partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to train and evaluate cutting\-edge AI models. You'll stress\-test AI reasoning on the toughest business problems, author gold\-standard solutions, and ensure these models are truly ready to function as sophisticated partners for executive decision\-making.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No prior AI experience needed — just deep business expertise and a sharp analytical mind.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Complex Business Challenges — Craft advanced business cases and quantitative problems spanning DCF valuation, market entry strategy, operations bottlenecks, cap table modeling, and more
* Author Ground\-Truth Solutions — Produce rigorous, step\-by\-step responses complete with financial statements, strategic frameworks (4Ps, 5Cs, Porter's Five Forces), and executive\-level rationales that serve as the "golden standard" for AI training
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI\-generated business plans, financial forecasts, and case study analyses for logical consistency, mathematical accuracy, and professional\-grade quality
* Sharpen AI Reasoning — Identify and document logical flaws in AI reasoning — such as ignoring sunk costs, miscalculating WACC, or failing to account for macroeconomic variables — and provide structured, actionable feedback


**Who You Are**
* Holder of a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from an accredited institution
* Strong foundational knowledge across at least two core business disciplines: Finance, Marketing, Operations, or Strategic Management
* Skilled at synthesizing complex data into clear, executive\-style analysis and recommendations
* Precise and methodical — you catch errors in financial formulas, data interpretation, and business logic
* Comfortable working independently and asynchronously on your own schedule
* No prior AI or data annotation experience required


**Nice to Have**
* Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate strategy
* Background in data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems
* Proficiency in data\-driven tools such as Excel financial modeling, Tableau, or SQL
* Experience producing board\-level or C\-suite communications and deliverables


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly with industry\-leading large language models at the frontier of AI development
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you, on your terms
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high\-impact project work
* Apply your business expertise to a domain that is reshaping the global economy
* Potential for ongoing work and contract renewals as new projects launch

Support R\&C and coordination of various stress test exercises and related approvals/governance, including coordination of inputs and evidence packs for exercises such as GIST/GRP/RST and relevant UK/Group regulatory requests (e.g., PRA\-related).

 We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.

 Domain Expertise

* Experience handling large\-scale banking and financial datasets.

title: Veg Oil Trader
description:
Cargill is a family company committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. We sit at the heart of the supply chain, partnering with producers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. By providing customers with life’s essentials, we enable businesses to grow, communities to prosper, and consumers to live well.
   

  

 This position is in our Ag \& Trading enterprise, where we connect producers and users of grains and oilseeds around the globe through origination, trading, processing, and distribution. We also offer a range of farmer services and risk management solutions.
   

  

 Job Purpose and Impact
   

  

 The Vege Oil Trader will be responsible for Merchandising Imported Edible Oil such as CPO, RBD Oln and SFO into the local Indian market from various port location but mainly pertaining to the East coast of India (KP/Kaki/Chennai/Haldia). In this role, you will monitor a supplier base and fulfill transactions, delivering commodities that meet production requirements and specifications in terms of timing, volume, quantity and cost.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

**Trading \& Commercial Strategy**
* Develop and execute profitable trading strategies for imported edible oils across Indian markets.
* Manage physical trading positions, inventory exposure, and pricing risk to optimize portfolio profitability.
* Identify and capture arbitrage opportunities between origins, ports, customer segments, and competing oils.
* Monitor global vegetable oil markets, including Palm Oil, Soybean Oil, Sunflower Oil, and related feedstocks, and translate market intelligence into actionable trading decisions.
* Build and maintain trading books to achieve volume, margin, and P\&L targets.


**Market Analysis \& Price Risk Management**
* Analyze domestic and international market fundamentals including supply\-demand balances, crop outlooks, import parity, crush economics, stock levels, and government policies.
* Monitor futures markets, basis relationships, currency movements, freight rates, and competitor activity to support trading decisions.
* Recommend pricing, hedging, and risk\-management strategies to manage market volatility and protect margins.
* Work closely with Risk Management and Trade Analytics teams to manage position exposure and portfolio performance.


**Customer \& Supplier Development**
* Build strategic relationships with refiners, food manufacturers, distributors, and trade houses across India.
* Identify new customer opportunities and develop trading solutions tailored to customer requirements.
* Negotiate commercial contracts involving pricing, volume, delivery terms, and payment structures.
* Collaborate with international trading desks and suppliers to optimize sourcing and trade flows.


**Portfolio Optimization \& Execution**
* Manage inventory and sales liquidation across bonded, high\-seas, and ex\-tank positions to maximize returns.
* Optimize freight, storage, and logistics economics to enhance trade margins.
* Ensure effective coordination with logistics, execution, finance, quality, credit, and operations teams to support seamless trade execution.
* Evaluate inventory holding strategies and working capital impacts to maximize risk\-adjusted returns.


**Market Intelligence \& Collaboration**
* Partner closely with TDA and Market Intelligence teams to assess:
+ Domestic crushing margins and crush economics.
+ Import parity and export competitiveness.
+ Port stock positions and inventory trends.
+ Regional demand patterns and substitution dynamics between edible oils.

* Provide market insights and trade recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
* Contribute to regional and global market outlook discussions and commercial strategy development.


**Qualifications**
* Strong understanding of vegetable oil fundamentals, futures markets, risk management, and physical commodity trading.
* Proven ability to interpret market data and convert insights into profitable trading decisions.
* Experience managing physical positions, customer portfolios, and price\-risk exposure.
* Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and relationship management capabilities.
* Ability to make decisions in fast\-moving and volatile commodity markets.
* P\&L\-driven mindset with a strong focus on value creation and margin optimization.

title: Principal Legal Counsel
description:
**Position Objectives:** 



* To formulate legal strategies and manage PETA India litigation across various forums, including engaging, briefing and assisting external counsel, drafting pleadings and attending hearings.
* To ensure that PETA India staff members are operating with sound knowledge of the law and using the strongest legal arguments to advance and meet our objectives.
* To draft internal legal documents, issue legal notices or complaints to authorities on behalf of PETA India in relation to different aspects of animal cruelty.



**Term of Employment:** 




 Full\-time
 



**Reports to:** 




 Associate General Counsel, Legal Affairs
 



**Location:** 




 Delhi
 



**Primary Responsibilities and Duties:** 



* Gather references for reliable external counsels to handle various PETA India cases and manage relations, including terms of engagement, with them, as assigned.
* Meet with external counsels regularly, sensitising them to PETA India’s positions and desired outcomes, and consult with counsels on court and campaign strategy.
* Ensure factual updates and adequate assistance to external counsels through routine briefing meetings, briefing or argument notes, list of dates, research notes or other material as requested by the counsel.
* Draft legal documents such as police complaints, complaint letters to authorities, legal notices, court pleadings and agreements based on thorough research and sound legal knowledge and arguments.
* Attending hearings before various forums, including the Supreme Court, High Courts and trial courts and assist the arguing counsel in the course of the hearing
* Draft and review in\-house legal documents and processes, such as agreements, SOPs, etc. and manage any litigation arising from the same
* Conduct thorough legal research for ongoing and proposed litigation, recommend sound strategies and take active part in internal and external strategy discussions
* Remain up\-to\-date with relevant legal developments, such as laws, amendments, rules, notifications, case\-laws. Research, interpret, and apply pertinent central government and state statutes, regulations, case law, government circulars, notifications and other relevant legal material to ongoing campaigns and litigation.
* Exercise due diligence and be impeccably organised, including by maintaining neat and clear records of correspondence, court\-related documents and other documentation.
* Ensure that the organisation’s work conforms with legal requirements, review internal SOPs and other policies, as assigned.
* Carefully and critically review letters, complaints, reports and other such documents from other departments to ensure PETA India staff members are operating with sound knowledge of the law and using the strongest legal arguments to advance and meet our objectives.
* Provide campaigners, researchers, investigators, and caseworkers with other legal support, including by taking part in strategy\-setting brainstorms where required
* Monitor issues and cases for potential legal action
* Perform any other duties assigned by the supervisor



**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in law (LLB) from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India. Master’s degree in a related field (LLM, Public Policy) a plus. Specialisation in constitutional law, environment law or animal rights a plus.
* Good standing to practise law and registration with a State Bar Council.
* At least seven years of work experience as a practising lawyer/in\-house counsel, with the primary area of practice being litigation
* At least 3 years of litigation experience in High Courts and/or Supreme Court (writ jurisdiction/public interest litigation). Sound knowledge of criminal law a plus
* Knowledge and experience of in\-house work such as drafting of agreements with external parties, employment contracts a plus
* Knowledge of applicable regulatory regimes such as the Foreign Contribution Regulation Act, other RBI guidelines and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 a plus.
* Strong commitment to animal rights issues and the philosophy/objectives of PETA India
* Proven excellent legal research and drafting skills
* Proven excellent strategic thinking, leadership and analytical skills. Leadership and management experience a plus
* Proven ability to handle multiple tasks within strict time constraints
* Willingness to travel extensively (as needed)
* Fluent in English, both spoken and written
* Fluency in spoken and written Hindi a plus
* Knowledge of regional Indian languages (apart from Hindi) a plus
* Professional appearance and adherence to a healthy vegan lifestyle



**How to Apply:** 




 To apply for a position with People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA) India, please complete this form.

title: Responsible AI Manager
description:
**Responsible AI Manager** 




  





**Location** 
 : Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience** 
 : 8\-12 years of relevant experience
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm known for entrepreneurial, action\-oriented professionals who take a hands\-on approach to solving complex client problems and delivering measurable results. The firm’s culture values independent thinkers and doers, guided by Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity. In 2023, A\&M established a high\-quality Global Capability Center in India to support end\-to\-end case delivery, thought leadership, specialized talent, automation, and faster collaboration across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The 900\+ member GCC works with business units across Consumer \& Retail, Healthcare, Software \& Technology, Automotive \& Industrials, Hospitality \& Leisure, Energy \& Natural Resources, and Financial Services. Unlike a traditional back\-office model, the center partners directly with global case teams to create client and business impact. The role joins the newly formed Global AI \& Knowledge Organization, led by the Chief AI \& Knowledge Officer, alongside product and technology, change management, knowledge management, operations, value, and governance teams.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Responsible AI Manager will help build and operationalize Alvarez \& Marsal’s global responsible AI capability from the ground up. The role owns the governance mechanisms that determine how AI is assessed, approved, deployed, monitored, and retired across internal, vendor, and client\-facing use cases. You will combine technical depth in data, AI/ML systems, architecture, security, and lifecycle controls with strong governance judgment. Working with GAIKO, IT, Risk, Information Security, Legal, Compliance, and the AI Operating Committee, you will establish practical standards that protect confidentiality, privacy, fairness, security, and client trust without slowing responsible innovation. Success means creating a repeatable operating model, improving decision quality, making risk visible to senior leaders, and embedding responsible AI into delivery and adoption practices across geographies.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the global Responsible AI framework, including policies, standards, intake, use\-case approval, risk escalation, and operating interfaces with existing technology risk review forums.
* Define lifecycle controls for AI development and deployment, covering sandbox environments, data permissions, architecture reviews, promotion gates, approval forums, client\-facing use, and decommissioning.
* Lead technical and responsible AI assessments of vendor tools, partnerships, internally built systems, agentic workflows, and engagement\-team prototypes, challenging evidence on data handling, residency, security, bias, and confidentiality.
* Establish pre\-deployment ethics reviews covering impact assessments, fairness testing, documentation, transparency, accuracy, escalation paths, and sign\-off criteria for models and tools.
* Build the global AI risk taxonomy, register, monitoring, and audit mechanisms, tracking model drift, performance degradation, data\-control violations, regulatory gaps, and lifecycle accountability.
* Create client AI review processes, delivery playbooks, employee guidelines, and adoption materials that embed responsible AI into project lifecycles and make compliant use practical across practices and regions.
* Prepare executive reporting on AI risk posture, decisions, exceptions, and remediation for the AI Operating Committee, AI Board, and client audiences when required.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* 8–12 years of experience with at least 2 years in AI governance, responsible AI, technology risk, data governance, security/GRC engineering, ML engineering, data engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to build governance frameworks, risk programs, compliance functions, policies, standards, controls, and operating models, preferably while standing up a new function or practice.
* Hands\-on understanding of data flows, data architecture, data pipelines, model lifecycles, API and integration architecture, agentic patterns, MCP\-style integrations, cloud residency, and security controls.
* Strong working knowledge of EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, GDPR, India’s DPDP Act, and related global privacy, security, and AI requirements.
* Experience conducting security assessments, controls reviews, governance compliance activities, third\-party/vendor assessments, and risk evaluations with the ability to challenge technical claims.
* Ability to communicate complex technical and governance issues clearly to practitioners, business stakeholders, executive committees, C\-suite leaders, and client audiences.
* Proven ability to influence without authority and drive implementation across matrixed, fast\-paced, geographically distributed professional services environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Consulting or professional services experience in an internal responsible AI function or client advisory role covering AI strategy, risk, compliance, or technology governance.
* Familiarity with enterprise AI and LLM platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or comparable tools, including confidentiality, residency, and data\-handling considerations.
* Certifications such as GRCP, CIPP, CRISC, IEEE CertifAIEd, Trustworthy AI, or another relevant responsible AI, privacy, security, or risk credential.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* You bring technical credibility across AI/ML systems, data governance, architecture, security controls, and lifecycle management, enabling you to assess how systems actually work rather than reviewing policy in isolation.
* You bring governance\-building experience, with the judgment to convert regulatory expectations and risk principles into practical standards, decision rights, control points, and operating routines.
* You bring balanced stakeholder leadership, partnering effectively with engineers, data teams, Information Security, Legal, Risk, Compliance, delivery leaders, and executives while maintaining independent challenge.
* You bring an implementation mindset suited to a newly formed, high\-urgency global organization: you can create structure from ambiguity, prioritize material risks, influence without authority, and deliver usable tools that improve adoption and client trust.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Shape a global responsible AI function at an early stage, defining its charter, roadmap, operating model, controls, and influence across a rapidly growing consulting organization.
* Work alongside senior leaders and global practitioners on AI transformation that directly affects client delivery, firm risk, technology choices, and the future of professional services.
* Grow in an entrepreneurial culture that rewards impact, continuous learning, independent thinking, collaboration, and meaningful contributions to complex business outcomes.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A high\-impact opportunity within A\&M’s newly formed Global AI \& Knowledge Organization, with exposure to global leadership, emerging AI use cases, and enterprise\-level governance decisions.
* A culture of meritocracy with structured performance development, technical training, formal learning, and on\-the\-job opportunities to expand your expertise and career trajectory.
* Benefits and well\-being resources designed to support your professional growth and personal journey, alongside a collaborative and inclusive working environment.

title: Lead Controller - Immediate joiner
description:
**About the Company:** 




 Relay Human Cloud is a young \& dynamic company that helps some of the top US\-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting \& Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high\-quality operations in cutting\-edge companies for their entire careers.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 The Lead Controller \- Financial Reporting, Close and Audit will serve as the primary accounting lead for the Company's monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting processes. This individual will coordinate and review the close, prepare consolidated financial information, oversee audit support, and ensure that accounting work is complete, accurate, well documented, and delivered on schedule. The role is hands\-on and requires an experienced accounting professional who can review detailed work, identify unsupported or unusual balances, resolve issues, and communicate clearly with the Chief Financial Officer, accounting personnel, and external auditors. Final accounting judgments, SEC accountability, treasury strategy, tax strategy, and executive\-level communications remain with the Chief Financial Officer.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Financial Close and Consolidation** 




 • Own and administer the monthly, quarterly, and annual close calendar, including deadlines, dependencies, responsibilities, and escalation points.
 



 • Coordinate close activities across the Company's legal entities, business units, and accounting resources.
 



 • Review journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and supporting schedules.
 



 • Ensure all material balance\-sheet accounts are reconciled, supported, and reviewed each reporting period.
 



 • Identify and resolve unexplained balances, aged reconciling items, classification errors, duplicate entries, and other accounting discrepancies.
 



 • Maintain discipline over period close, reopening periods, late entries, and post\-close adjustments.
 



 • Maintain a complete, organized, and audit\-ready electronic close binder.
 



**Financial Reporting** 




 • Prepare and review consolidated balance sheets, statements of operations, statements of cash flows, and related supporting schedules.
 



 • Prepare monthly management reporting packages and clear explanations of material financial\-statement variances.
 



 • Review reported results for unusual trends, period\-over\-period inconsistencies, margin anomalies, and potential accounting errors.
 



 • Maintain the chart of accounts, financial\-statement mapping, consolidation structure, and reporting hierarchy.
 



 • Prepare financial\-statement and footnote support for quarterly and annual SEC filings.
 



 • Perform or coordinate financial\-statement, disclosure, and XBRL tie\-outs and maintain supporting workpapers.
 



**Technical Accounting Support** 




 • Research U.S. GAAP requirements applicable to Company transactions and accounting matters.
 



 • Prepare initial technical accounting analyses and memorandum drafts for Chief Financial Officer review.
 



 • Identify transactions requiring additional accounting analysis, documentation, or external consultation.
 



 • Support accounting for revenue recognition, leases, inventory, stock\-based compensation, discontinued operations, impairments, contingencies, acquisitions, divestitures, and other relevant matters.
 



 • Assist with implementation of new accounting standards and updates to accounting policies.
 



 • Escalate material, unusual, or judgmental accounting matters promptly.
 



**Audit and Quarterly Review Support** 




 • Manage detailed coordination of the annual audit and quarterly review processes.
 



 • Maintain the auditor request list, assign responsibility for requested items, and monitor completion.
 



 • Review schedules and supporting documentation before submission to the external auditors.
 



 • Coordinate responses among accounting personnel, operating teams, and external service providers.
 



 • Track proposed adjustments, passed adjustments, control observations, and unresolved audit matters.
 



 • Identify recurring audit issues and coordinate corrective actions with responsible personnel.
 



 • Escalate potential reporting delays or unresolved audit matters to the Chief Financial Officer.
 



**Internal Controls and Team Coordination** 




 • Maintain financial\-close and financial\-reporting controls, including evidence of preparation and review.
 



 • Maintain accounting policies, close procedures, review checklists, control documentation, and reporting workpapers.
 



 • Identify control failures, documentation deficiencies, and recurring process breakdowns and coordinate remediation.
 



 • Provide day\-to\-day coordination and review of the Accounting Operations Controller and other outsourced accounting resources.
 



 • Maintain an open\-items list covering unresolved accounting, reporting, audit, and control matters.
 



 • Establish clear expectations, review work for quality and completeness, and escalate issues early with recommended solutions.
 



 • Improve documentation and cross\-training to reduce key\-person dependency.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a closely related field.
 



 • CPA, Chartered Accountant, ACCA, or comparable professional accounting designation.
 



 • At least 10 years of progressive accounting and financial\-reporting experience.
 



 • Prior experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, Financial Reporting Director, Audit Manager, or comparable accounting leader.
 



 • Direct experience supporting a U.S. publicly traded company and working within a public\-company reporting calendar.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and experience preparing or reviewing consolidated financial statements.
 



 • Experience with multi\-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany eliminations.
 



 • Experience supporting Forms 10\-Q and 10\-K, including financial\-statement and disclosure support.
 



 • Experience working directly with external auditors in a PCAOB audit environment.
 



 • Demonstrated ability to review reconciliations, identify accounting problems, and drive issues to resolution.
 



 • Strong technical accounting research, written documentation, and English communication skills.
 



 • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong proficiency with ERP and financial\-reporting systems.
 



 • Ability to supervise and review the work of remote accounting personnel.
 



 • Ability to provide meaningful recurring work\-hour overlap with U.S. Central Time, with expanded availability during close and reporting periods.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • Prior public accounting experience with a national or regional accounting firm.
 



 • Experience in inventory\-intensive distribution, foodservice, retail, e\-commerce, logistics, or a related industry.
 



 • Experience remediating audit findings, significant deficiencies, material weaknesses, or other internal\-control issues.
 



 • Demonstrated success improving the accuracy, timeliness, or predictability of a financial close.
 



 • Experience implementing or optimizing an ERP, consolidation platform, close\-management system, or financial\-reporting tool.
 



 • Experience supporting acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, discontinued operations, or other complex
 



  





**Why Join Relay Human Cloud? ✨** 




 🌍 Opportunities to work with global clients
 



 🤝 Dynamic and collaborative work environment
 



 ⚖️ Excellent work\-life balance – 5\-day workweek
 



 🩺 Comprehensive health \& accident insurance
 



 🌴 Generous paid time off and holidays
 



 🍽️ Complimentary lunches \& dinners
 



 🏆 Quarterly, Semi\-Annual \& Annual recognition, rewards, and giveaways
 



 📚 Employee development programs – Communication, Soft Skills, and more
 



 🎉 Vibrant cultural events – Fun Fridays, Month\-End Celebrations, Sports Tournaments, and Festival celebrations
 



 🎯 Excellent Employee Referral Program

**To Be Successful You Will**

Being a member of our Consulting team means you will specialize in a particular competency \- Risk, Technology Consulting, or IT Risk \& Assurance. **Role title**

**Position Summary:**
 The CRM Specialist (Supervising Associate) will own CRM opportunity tracking across Quantum/Physical AI/Other initiatives within EY’s Next Frontier workstream. The role will drive pipeline visibility, weekly reporting, conversion analysis and data accuracy to support strategic decisions and revenue growth.
   

  

 The role requires strong working knowledge of EY CRM and sales processes, advanced Excel skills, and the ability to translate pipeline data into clear insights for leadership and workstream teams. Experience generating reports using AI tools is preferred; Power BI is not required.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Ability to work independently while collaborating across global teams.

* Power BI experience is not required.


**Education and Experience:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Operations, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related discipline.

* Experience supporting leadership reviews or revenue pipeline discussions.

**Job Title: Company Secretary**
**Role Purpose**
 The Company Secretary will provide end‑to‑end corporate governance, statutory compliance, and board‑support services for the company’s Indian entities. The role ensures that all corporate records, filings, and governance processes meet applicable legal, regulatory, and internal standards. The position requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work closely with senior leadership across Legal, Finance, HR, and Operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Corporate Governance \& Board Support**
* Manage board and committee meetings, including scheduling, agenda preparation, circulation of papers, and minute‑taking.
* Maintain statutory registers, corporate records, and entity‑level documentation in accordance with the Companies Act and internal governance frameworks.
* Ensure timely execution, notarisation, apostille, and safe custody of corporate documents.
* Support directors with governance queries, declarations, and compliance requirements.


**Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance**
* Prepare and file statutory returns with the Registrar of Companies and other authorities (MCA, RBI, etc.).
* Monitor regulatory changes and ensure the company remains compliant with all applicable laws.
* Coordinate annual filings, board resolutions, shareholder resolutions, and event‑based filings.
* Liaise with external regulators, auditors, and advisors as required.


**Entity Management \& Corporate Actions**
* Maintain the corporate database and ensure entity information is accurate and up to date.
* Support incorporations, amendments, director appointments/removals, share transfers, and other corporate actions.
* Draft and review board resolutions, powers of attorney, and governance documents.


**Internal Coordination \& Support**
* Work closely with Legal, Finance, HR, and Operations to ensure governance requirements are embedded in business processes.
* Support internal audits, compliance reviews, and group governance initiatives.
* Provide guidance to internal stakeholders on governance standards and statutory obligations.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Qualified Company Secretary (ICSI) with 3–7 years of post‑qualification experience.
* Strong knowledge of the Companies Act, MCA processes, and corporate governance best practices.
* Experience managing multiple entities within a group structure is preferred.
* Excellent drafting, minute‑taking, and organisational skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and interact confidently with senior stakeholders.
* High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism.


**Personal Attributes**
* Detail‑oriented with strong ownership and accountability.
* Proactive, organised, and able to manage competing priorities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder‑management skills.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work across functions and jurisdictions.


 Additional Information

title: Real Estate Transaction Management
description:
**Job Description – Transaction Management (Key Accounts)**




  





**Position Summary** 




 The Transaction Management is the
 **senior strategic leader** 
 responsible for shaping, governing, and delivering the real estate transaction strategy for high‑value key client accounts across India. This role demands exceptional executive presence, a strong command of commercial real estate markets, and the capability to influence C‑suite stakeholders within client organizations and CBRE.
 



 They will function as the
 **single point of accountability** 
 for the client’s real estate portfolio performance, ensuring alignment with global corporate strategies, driving continuous optimization, and leading multi‑disciplinary teams to deliver excellence across all real estate transaction lifecycle stages.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Portfolio Ownership** 



* Define and lead the India\-wide real estate transaction strategy, ensuring alignment with regional and global CRE directives.
* Challenge and influence client leadership through data\-backed insights, scenario modelling, and long‑range portfolio planning.
* Anticipate market shifts, business expansions, regulatory trends, and commercial risks to proactively shape client’s real estate strategy.
* Drive enterprise\-level outcomes including cost optimization, footprint rationalization, portfolio resilience, and operational agility.



**2\. Executive Stakeholder Management** 



* Serve as a senior strategic partner to the Client’s Corporate Real Estate (CRE) leadership and business unit heads, building trusted relationships across decision‑making levels.
* Lead key client engagement forums including business reviews, portfolio strategy sessions, governance meetings, and performance discussions.
* Ensure consistent communication, seamless service delivery, and proactive issue resolution across all touchpoints.
* Serve as the senior\-most relationship partner to the client’s leadership, building trust and influencing strategic decisions.
* Lead governance forums including quarterly business reviews, portfolio steering committees, and annual planning workshops.
* Engage with C‑suite stakeholders across Business Leadership, CRE, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Projects, Audit, and Facilities.



**3\. End‑to‑End Transaction Governance** 



* Initiate, oversee, and close transactions across renewals, acquisitions, expansions, consolidations, dispositions—ensuring strategy, risk, and compliance alignment.
* Ensure full adherence to client governance frameworks, including policy controls, audit requirements, global playbooks, and approval matrices.
* Translate client business drivers into actionable portfolio and transactional strategies.
* Lead negotiations, collaborating closely with brokerage teams, legal counsel, finance, and other internal stakeholders to secure optimal commercial and contractual outcomes.
* Provide direction and governance to brokers, third‑party partners, and Lease Documentation Specialists.
* Develop and enforce high‑performance operating models for transaction execution, documentation quality, and service consistency.
* Provide oversight for complex legal negotiations across LOIs, MOUs, lease agreements, sale deeds, and termination documents.
* Establish and maintain robust risk‑mitigation frameworks for commercial, contractual, and operational exposures.
* Drive standardization of templates, processes, governance models, and reporting formats across India portfolios.



**4\. Analytical Mindset** 



* Lead financial modelling, investment analysis, NPV/IRR assessments, portfolio benchmarking, and business case development.
* Perform market and financial analysis and ensure accurate data for each transaction, translate analytics into board\-ready recommendations.
* Partner with Finance leadership to shape the Annual Operating Plan, RE Budgets, Capital Planning, and cost‑efficiency strategies.
* Drive disciplined performance management across KPIs, SLAs, savings targets, and operational scorecards.



**5\. People Manager and Team Player** 



* Provide strategic leadership to transaction managers, analysts, and cross‑functional delivery teams.
* Partner closely with Projects, Facilities Management, Advisory \& Consulting, Research, Risk, and Legal to deliver integrated real estate solutions.
* Foster a culture of accountability, excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Mentor high‑potential talent and contribute to CBRE’s leadership development initiatives.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* **Strategic Vision** 
 : Ability to define long‑term portfolio strategies, influence C‑suite decision‑making.
* **Commercial \& Financial Acumen** 
 – Strong expertise in real estate economics, deal structuring, financial modelling, and business case development.
* **Executive Communication** 
 – Confident presenter with the ability to articulate complex insights to senior leaders.
* **Negotiation Mastery** 
 – Advanced capability in commercial negotiations and contract structures.
* **Operational Excellence** 
 – Strong focus on governance, quality control, compliance, and disciplined execution.
* **Relationship Intelligence** 
 – Skilled in navigating large, matrixed organizations and influencing without authority.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Postgraduate or bachelor’s degree in real estate, Finance, Business Administration, or related fields.
* 10 –15\+ years of progressive experience in corporate real estate, transaction management, portfolio strategy. (Mumbai – Pune – Bengaluru \- Hyderabad)
* Significant experience managing real estate for multinational occupier clients.
* Proven track record of managing senior stakeholders, large teams, and complex cross\-functional engagements.
* Ability to work effectively and lead a team in a cohesive, performance measured environment.
* Balance multiple responsibilities and deliverables while ensuring client satisfaction
* Strong proficiency in MS Office, financial modelling, and CRE technology platforms.

The organization has grown into a team of over 600 professionals and more than 70 Registered Migration Agents, supporting over 195,000 individuals, 9,000 students annually, and 200\+ global artists and professionals. Aussizz Group combines human\-centered guidance with innovative digital tools and a large network of offices to simplify complex visa and migration processes. The company emphasizes integrity, dignity, and opportunity, focusing on long\-term futures for clients rather than just paperwork. Team members join a mission\-driven environment dedicated to helping people belong, thrive, and contribute globally.

 The Visa Counsellor will provide end\-to\-end guidance to clients on visa and migration pathways, including study, work, and permanent residency options. This full\-time, on\-site role in Ahmedabad involves conducting consultations, assessing client eligibility, explaining documentation requirements, and supporting clients through application processes and timelines. The individual will prepare and review forms, ensure accuracy and compliance with relevant immigration regulations, and coordinate with Registered Migration Agents as needed. Daily responsibilities include maintaining detailed client records, managing follow\-ups, responding to queries via in\-person meetings, phone, and email, and proactively updating clients about application status and policy changes. The role also involves collaborating with internal teams, participating in information sessions or seminars, and contributing to a supportive, ethical, and client\-focused service culture.

title: Compliance Officer
description:
Location: Kochi, Kerala
 



 Experience : Minimum: 5\+ years in compliance, audit, risk management, or regulatory functions.
 



 Work Model: Work From Office
 



  





 The Compliance Officer plays a critical role in safeguarding the integrity of client entities by ensuring that their operations adhere to all relevant legal, regulatory, and statutory requirements. The primary responsibility is to support and oversee the compliance framework for the allotted entities, ensuring that filings and submissions to government authorities are accurate, timely, and aligned with regulatory expectations.
 



  





 This role involves identifying applicable laws, monitoring potential areas of non\-adherence, and assisting in the implementation of effective strategies to ensure compliance across assigned entities. The Compliance Officer will also help foster a culture of responsibility by maintaining policies, conducting basic risk reviews, and coordinating with internal teams and external consultants to promote consistent regulatory adherence.
 



  





 By ensuring that all assigned entities meet the required standards of regulatory and ethical conduct, the Compliance Officer contributes to maintaining their legal standing, operational stability, and reputation.
 



 Primary duties and responsibilities:
 


* Regulatory Adherence – Ensure the organization’s operations for allotted entities fully comply with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies.
* Statutory Filings \& Submissions – Oversee accuracy and timeliness of all filings and submissions to regulatory authorities.
* Policy Implementation \& Monitoring – Develop, implement, and enforce compliance procedures and policies; ensure business units operate within legal and regulatory frameworks.
* Risk Assessment \& Management – Conduct regular risk assessments to identify potential areas of non\-compliance; recommend and monitor preventive and corrective actions.
* Reporting \& Monitoring – Maintain compliance records and reporting systems; provide regular updates and performance reports.
* Investigation \& Remediation – Investigate potential compliance breaches, implement corrective measures, and ensure preventive actions are in place.
* Management Assurance – Provide periodic assurance to senior management on the overall compliance status, highlighting key risks, corrective actions taken, and areas requiring attention.



 Secondary duties and responsibilities:
 


* Collaboration with Departments – Coordinate with internal teams and external consultants to ensure compliance adherence across all business operations.
* Training \& Awareness – Facilitate training sessions and awareness programs for employees regarding regulatory requirements and internal policies.
* Monitoring Regulatory Changes – Track updates in laws and regulations; ensure timely amendments to policies and procedures.
* Audit Support – Assist in internal and external audits, ensuring compliance issues are addressed and audit recommendations implemented.
* Continuous Improvement – Identify trends, recurring issues, or process gaps; recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce risk exposure.



 Qualification \& Experience:
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* Strong knowledge or ability to understand applicable laws, regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Minimum: 5\+ years in compliance, audit, risk management, or regulatory functions.
* Experience in maintaining records, monitoring statutory requirements, and supporting filings or audits.
* Exposure to BPO/back\-office or multi\-entity environments is a plus.
* Experience in AML (Anti\-Money Laundering) \& CFT (Combating the Financing of Terrorism) compliance.
* Exposure to insurance broking, aviation, or other regulated industries.
